subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: Single row tapered roller bearings are designed to accommodate combined radial and axial loads and provide low friction during operation. The inner ring, with rollers and cage, can be mounted separately from the outer ring. These separable and interchangeable components facilitate mounting, dismounting and maintenance. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are : High radial and axial load carrying capacity, High radial and axial load carrying capacity, Low friction and long service life, Separable and interchangeable components. Applications : Wheel hubs, Transmissions and gearboxes, Construction equipment, Agricultural machinery, Mining equipment, Conveyor systems, Electric motors. J2 : Pressed Steel Window-Type Cage, Q : Optimized Internal Geometry And Surface Finish.

These bearing is a high-precision drawn cup needle roller bearing manufactured by INA. It features a compact radial design engineered to support heavy radial loads in spaces with limited installation volume. The bearing features a closed cup on one side, which seals the end of a shaft, retains lubricant, and protects the internal components from external contaminants. The outer housing is made of cold-formed, thin-walled sheet steel, providing maximum radial performance with minimal outer diameter clearance. Material : Made of high-purity, through-hardened carbon-chromium steel with a cold-formed sheet steel outer cup. Features are : Built-in Lubrication Groove, Extremely Low Cross-Section, Low Mass Moment of Inertia, Oscillating Motion Accommodation, Low Operating Torque, Shell Wall Profile, High-Speed Operating Limits. Applications : Automotive Transmissions & Gearboxes, Industrial Automation & Robotics, Power Tools & Outdoor Equipment, Textile & Printing Machinery, Medical Equipment & Lab Devices, Agricultural Feed & Seed Metering, Offshore & Marine Control Linkages. These bearing is a high-precision machined needle roller bearing with an inner ring manufactured by INA. It provides extreme structural rigidity and resists heavy deformation under high radial forces. This allows the inner ring, the outer ring, and the cage assembly to be mounted independently, vastly simplifying assembly and maintenance workflows. The rolling elements feature advanced logarithmic profiling. This subtle curvature at the tips of the needles prevents stress concentrations (edge stresses) during minor shaft misalignments or heavy deflections. Material : High-strength precision chrome alloy steel (typically 100Cr6) with a durable steel or polyamide cage. Features are : Compact Cross-Section, Superfinished Raceways, Low Frictional Torque, High Acceleration Capability, Thermal & Environmental Resilience, Bi-Directional Axial Displacement, Logarithmic Profile Rollers. Applications : Construction & Agricultural Machinery, CNC Machine Tool Spindles, Textile Processing Machinery, Printing & Paper Presses, Aerospace, Defense & Marine Subsystems, Renewable Energy, Metal Rolling and Slitting Mills, Packaging Machinery, Woodworking Machinery. NA=Needle Roller Bearing With a Removable Ground Inner Ring.

They can be used in a modular system, including housings, sleeves and nuts. Applications : Heavy machinery (construction and mining equipment), Industrial gearboxes, Wind turbines (rotor assembly), Material handling equipment, Pulp and paper mills. CC : Two Window-Type Steel Cages, Flangeless Inner Ring And Guide Ring Centered On The Inner Ring.

Additionally, they can accommodate axial forces in both directions. subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: Single row tapered roller bearings are designed to accommodate combined radial and axial loads and provide low friction during operation. Single row tapered roller bearings are designed to accommodate combined radial and axial loads and provide low friction during operation. The inner ring, with rollers and cage, can be mounted separately from the outer ring. These separable and interchangeable components facilitate mounting, dismounting and maintenance. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are : High radial and axial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads in one direction, Low friction and long service life, Separable and interchangeable components. Applications : Automotive wheel hubs, Gearboxes, Construction equipment, Conveyor systems, Other industrial machinery requiring efficient transmission of radial and axial forces.

The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: Single row tapered roller bearings are designed to accommodate combined radial and axial loads and provide low friction during operation. The inner ring, with rollers and cage, can be mounted separately from the outer ring. These separable and interchangeable components facilitate mounting, dismounting and maintenance. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are : High radial and axial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads in one direction, Low friction and long service life, Separable and interchangeable components. The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: Single row tapered roller bearings are designed to accommodate combined radial and axial loads and provide low friction during operation. The inner ring, with rollers and cage, can be mounted separately from the outer ring. These separable and interchangeable components facilitate mounting, dismounting and maintenance. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are :  High radial and axial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads in one direction, Low friction and long service life, Separable and interchangeable components. Applications : Automotive wheels, Transmissions and gearboxes, Electric motors, pumps, and fans, Material handling equipment, Paper mills and cement plants, Rolling mills, Power generation,Off-road and earth-moving equipment.

The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity.  SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: Single row tapered roller bearings are designed to accommodate combined radial and axial loads and provide low friction during operation. The inner ring, with rollers and cage, can be mounted separately from the outer ring. These separable and interchangeable components facilitate mounting, dismounting and maintenance. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are : High radial and axial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads in one direction, Low friction and long service life, Separable and interchangeable components. Applications : Pumping equipment, Industrial fans, Heavy-duty manufacturing equipment, Automotive applications, Machine tools, Electric motors, Wind turbines, Mining and construction equipment.

The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing.

tech: Single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and one on the inner ring, NJ design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in one direction. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In One Direction, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, P= Injection Moulded Cage Of Glass Fibre Reinforced Polyamide 6,6, Roller Centered.

Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and one integral flange and one loose flange ring on the inner ring, NUP design bearings can locate the shaft axially in both directions. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In Both Direction, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, J= Pressed Steel Cage, Roller Centered, Unhardened.

An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, M= Two-Piece Machined Brass Cage, Roller Centered.

Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and no flanges on the inner ring, NU design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in both directions. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, P= Injection Moulded Cage Of Glass Fibre Reinforced Polyamide 6,6, Roller Centered.

An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In One Direction, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, PH= Injection Moulded Cage Of Glass Fibre Reinforced Polyetheretherketone (PEEK), Roller Centered.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: These bearing is a premium-grade, single-row series cylindrical roller bearing manufactured by the SKF Group. The outer ring to displace axially relative to the inner ring in both directions, making it ideal for non-locating position shaft systems. Material : The bearing components are crafted from ultra-clean, through-hardened high-carbon chromium steel for maximum wear resistance, paired with a resilient pressed sheet-metal steel cage for vibration durability. Features are : Spherical Roller Ends, Smooth Outer Ring, Non-Locating Axial Displacement, Thermal Management, Easy Maintenance, Logarithmic Roller Profile, Super-Finished Raceways, Low Heat Generation. Applications : Heavy-Duty Industrial Gearboxes, Electric Motors & Generators, Industrial Pumps & Compressors, Agricultural Tractors & Combines, Construction & Earthmoving Machinery, Material Handling Conveyors, Industrial Fans & Blowers, Pulp & Paper Processing Mills, Textile & Printing Machinery, Marine Propulsion Systems, Mining & Aggregate Crushers. subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: These bearing is a highly specialised, premium-grade single-row cylindrical roller bearing engineered by SKF for high-load industrial machinery. The \"NUP\" designation means it is a locating bearing, meaning it handles dominant radial loads while completely locking the shaft axially from both directions. The outer ring is built with two integrated fixed flanges. The inner ring features one integrated fixed flange and one loose flange ring (thrust collar). This architecture enables full bi-directional axial containment, keeping gearsets or shafts perfectly centered against thrust forces. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Extreme Temperature Resilience. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. An annular groove in the outer ring enables the bearings to retain a snap ring. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In Both Direction, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, N= Snap Ring Groove In The Outer Ring, P= Injection Moulded Cage Of Glass Fibre Reinforced Polyamide 6,6, Roller Centered.

Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and one on the inner ring, NJ design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in one direction. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In One Direction, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, M= Two-Piece Machined Brass Cage, Roller Centered.

Applications : Power Transmission & Drivetrains, Mining & Quarrying Equipment, Material Handling Conveyors, Construction Machinery, Fluid Handling & Air Moving Systems, Paper & Pulp Processing Machinery, Industrial Printing Presses. A=Cylindrical Roller Bearing, With 1 Degree 40 Minute Flange Angle, Spherical Roller Ends, MB=Two-Piece Machined Brass Cage, Inner Ring Guided.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units

Applications : Power Generators, Large Electric Motors, Quarrying & Mining Equipment, Construction Machinery,  Pulp and Paper Mills, Marine Propulsion Systems, Textile Manufacturing Machines, Industrial Gearboxes & Transmissions, Industrial Compressors & Fans. A=Cylindrical Roller Bearing, With 1 Degree 40 Minute Flange Angle, Spherical Roller Ends, MB=Two-Piece Machined Brass Cage, Inner Ring Guided.

Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and one on the inner ring, NJ design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in one direction. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In One Direction, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, P= Injection Moulded Cage Of Glass Fibre Reinforced Polyamide 6,6, Roller Centered.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units

A=Cylindrical Roller Bearing, With 1 Degree 40 Minute Flange Angle, Spherical Roller Ends, MB=Two-Piece Machined Brass Cage, Inner Ring Guided.

Features are : Accommodate misalignment and axial displacement within the bearing, High radial load carrying capacity, Provide frictionless axial movement, Long bearing system life, Sealed for increased reliability. Applications : Steelmaking and Rolling Mills, Pulp and Paper Industry, Material Handling, Mining, Mineral Processing, and Cement, Power Generation. 2CS5=Sheet Steel Reinforced Contact Seal Of Hydrogenated Acrylonitrile Butadiene Rubber (HNBR) On Both Sides. Free Space In The Bearing Filled Between 70 And 100% With A High Temperature Grease, V=Full Complement Of Rollers (No Cage), GEM9=Filled To 70 – 100% With SKF LGHB 2 Grease.

CARB toroidal roller bearings are unique as well as accommodating misalignment without increased stress levels, they also provide frictionless axial movement within the bearing in the non-locating position in self-aligning bearing arrangements. This full complement bearing, which has a lower speed rating, uses as many rollers as possible, giving it the highest possible load rating. Features are : Accommodate misalignment and axial displacement within the bearing, Very high radial load carrying capacity, Provide frictionless axial movement, Long bearing system life. Applications : Industrial Controls, Crushers and Grinding Machines, Textile Machinery, Power Systems. V=Full Complement Of Rollers (No Cage), VE240=Bearing Modified For Greater Axial Displacement.

Feature are : Accommodate misalignment and axial displacement within the bearing, High radial load carrying capacity, Provide frictionless axial movement, Long bearing system life, Reduce noise and vibration levels. Applications : Industrial Transmissions, Pulp & Paper Industry, Marine & Construction Machinery, Industrial Fans & Blowers.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: INSOCOAT single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. The applied electrically insulating coating on the outside surfaces of the outer or inner ring prevents electric current from passing through the bearings. Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and no flanges on the inner ring, NU design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in both directions. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Protected Against Electric Current Damage, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, M= Two-Piece Machined Brass Cage, Roller Centered, C3= Bearing Internal Clearance Greater Than Normal, VL0241= Electrical Insulation Of Outer Ring, Breakdown Voltage DC 3.000 V, Ohmic Resistance 200 MΩ.

The THK RB...UUC0 bearing is a high-rigidity, split-outer-ring cross-roller ring designed for applications requiring exceptional inner-ring rotation accuracy. Its unique internal structure allows a single bearing to handle complex combined loads that would typically require multiple conventional bearings. The RB type features a two-piece outer ring held together by bolts or specialized retainers once the rollers are installed. This design allows for a one-piece inner ring, which is the \"basic form\" for high-precision rotary motion.  Rollers are arranged orthogonally (at 90-degree angles to each other) within the V-groove raceway. This \"crossed\" arrangement enables the bearing to support radial, axial, and moment loads simultaneously from any direction. Features are : Resin Spacer Retainers,High Rigidity with Minimal Footprint, Increased Load Capacity, Precision and Smoothness, Low Starting Torque, Integrated Lubrication System, Cost Efficiency in Assembly. Applications : Machine Tools, Medical Equipment, Aerospace and Defense, Semiconductor & LCD Manufacturing, Automotive & Transportation. UU=Seal Attached On Both Ends, C0=Radial Clearance Symbol (Medium Preload).

These bearing is a high-precision crossed roller bearing engineered by INA. Designed according to ISO dimension series 18 (DIN 616), it is highly rigid and optimized to handle multidirectional loads within an extremely compact physical space.  Cylindrical rollers are arranged perpendicularly to each other in a 90° V-groove raceway. This unique design allows a single bearing arrangement to replace a more complex two-bearing setup. To facilitate assembly and precise preload adjustment, the outer ring is split circumferentially and secured robustly by three integral retaining rings. Material : Manufactured from high-purity, through-hardened 100Cr6 chromium rolling bearing steel with polyamide plastic roller spacers. Features are : Low Friction Spacer Sleeves, Integrated Lubrication Path, Logarithmic Profile Rollers, Open & Unsealed Setup, Low Vibration Signature, Thermal Expansion Accommodation, Low Starting Torque, Limiting Speed. Applications : Robotics & Automation, Medical Technology & Imaging Systems, Aerospace, Defense & Optical Tracking, Material Handling & Special Logistics, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Construction Engineering, Renewable Energy Systems. A=Internal Design Modifier.

These bearing a high-precision, thin section crossed roller bearing from the SX series, designed to handle complex load combinations in a single bearing position. It corresponds to dimension series 18 according to DIN 616. This bearing features a unique structure where cylindrical rollers are arranged orthogonally (at 90°) in a V-groove raceway. This enables the bearing to simultaneously support radial loads, axial loads from both directions, and tilting moment loads. The outer ring is circumferentially split and held together by three retaining rings. This design simplifies installation and is ideal for applications where the inner ring rotates. Features are : High Rigidity & Precision, Wide Temperature Range, Reduced Friction and Heat, Reduced Maintenance Costs, Unsealed Design, Easy Installation, Simplified Design, High Speed Limits, Compact Envelope,Open Design. Applications : Robotics & Automation, Machine Tools, Medical Equipment, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Energy & Power Generation, Material Handling Systems, Packaging  & Textile Machinery. A=Modified Internal Design.

tech: These bearing is a highly specialized, high-precision single-row radial cylindrical roller bearing engineered by INA. This exact specification is widely utilized in high-performance industrial equipment, particularly favored as a vital component in printing press machinery assemblies. The outer ring features two fixed, integral rigid flanges. The inner ring features one fixed structural flange and one loose, detachable rib collar ring. This design allows the component to function as a locating bearing, absorbing heavy radial force while simultaneously guiding and securing the shaft against axial thrust loads in both directions. Material : Through-hardened 100Cr6 high-carbon chromium bearing steel with a solid steel cage. Features are : Low Friction Coefficient, Separable Component Design, High Shock Resistance, Low Heat Generation, Open Architecture for Integrated Lubrication, High Structural Rigidity, Thermal Limitations. Applications : Textile Manufacturing Machinery, Materials Handling & Logistics Systems, Industrial Pumps & Compressors, Construction Equipment, Packaging & Food Processing Automation, Metal Processing & Steel Mill Equipment. NUP=Single-Row Cylindrical Roller Bearing With Two Flanges On The Outer Ring, One Flange On The Inner Ring, and One Loose Flange Ring.

tech: These bearing is a high-capacity single-row radial cylindrical roller bearing engineered by INA. This specific part number is designed for high-stress industrial applications requiring extreme radial load support in a highly compact footprint, such as in hydraulic pumps, heavy-duty transmissions. This bearing features an open design with no integrated seals or shields. This allows for direct, unrestricted oil or grease lubrication flow across the rolling elements in enclosed systems like gearboxes. Material : Manufactured from ultra-clean, high-carbon through-hardened chrome steel for maximum wear and fatigue resistance. Features are : Axial Displacement Accommodation, Simultaneous Press-Fit Compatibility, High Kinematic Rigidity, Separable Structural Build, Elastohydrodynamic Lubrication Performance, High Boundary Fatigue Limit, Wide Thermal Limits. Applications : Construction and Earthmoving Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, Material Handling Systems, Industrial Printing Presses, Paper and Pulp Processing Rollers, Textile Manufacturing Loom Drives. NJ=Inner Ring Type.

These bearing is a single-row radial cylindrical roller bearing engineered without an inner ring. Manufactured by INA, it is designed for demanding industrial setups that prioritize radial load capacity over axial footprint space.  The \"RNU\" classification implies a cylindrical roller design completely devoid of an integrated inner ring. The cage and outer ring assembly run directly on a hardened, ground, and polished machine shaft spindle. This reduces the overall envelope size while maximizing shaft thickness for radial rigidity.  It features a cageless design completely packed with rolling elements. Without a cage taking up space, it maximizes the number of rollers to achieve the highest possible radial load capacity. Material : Constructed from premium GCr15 high-carbon chromium bearing steel for maximum wear resistance and structural stability. The Nadella RNA series is a single-row, full-complement needle roller bearing with machined outer rings, designed for exceptionally high load-carrying capacity in applications with limited radial space. The bearing utilizes the maximum possible number of needle rollers, meaning it has no cage. This design choice is what gives it its high static and dynamic load ratings. Features are : Compact Radial Cross-Section, Accommodates Oscillating Motion, Separable Components, Durability and Long Life, Cost-Effective Solution, Precision Tolerances, High Rigidity, Wide Temperature Range. Applications : Gearboxes and transmissions, Pumps and compressors, Textile machinery and machine tools, Conveyors and material handling equipment, Automotive transmissions, Power transmission systems, Agricultural machinery, Robotics, Construction and mining equipment.

Features are : Compact Radial Cross-Section, Accommodates Oscillating Motion, Separable Components, Durability and Long Life, Cost-Effective Solution, Precision Tolerances, High Rigidity, Wide Temperature Range. Applications : Gearboxes and transmissions, Pumps and compressors, Textile machinery and machine tools, Conveyors and material handling equipment, Automotive transmissions, Power transmission systems, Agricultural machinery, Robotics, Construction and mining equipment.

The absence of a cage allows for the maximum number of needle rollers to be incorporated, which significantly increases both the static and dynamic load capacities. Materials : Made from high-quality bearing steel. Features are : High load capacity, Compact size, High stiffness, Accommodates axial displacement, Tolerance and Precision Ratings, Effective Lubrication Management, Robustness in Extreme Conditions. Applications : Agricultural and construction equipment, Pumps and compressors, Conveyor systems, Textile and printing machinery, Machine tools, Mining equipment, Medical equipment.

desc: DRAWN CUP ROLLER BEARING WITH OPEN END
tech: The Nadella DL series is a full complement drawn cup needle roller bearing, designed for heavy radial loads in applications with limited mounting space. The full complement design means it has no cage and contains the maximum number of needle rollers, resulting in a higher dynamic load capacity than caged bearings of the same size. The bearing is manufactured from durable bearing steel by Nadella. Made from a thin sheet steel, the outer ring is drawn (deep drawn) to create a cost-effective, space-saving bearing design. Material : It is manufactured from high-quality bearing steel to ensure durability and resistance to wear. Features are : High Radial Stiffness, Compactness, Cost-effective maintenance, Pure Radial Load Support, Minimised Friction. Applications : Gearboxes and pumps, Conveyor system, Textile and printing presses, Power tools, Robotics, Automotive transmissions, Off-road and agricultural machinery.

The full complement design means it has no cage and contains the maximum number of needle rollers, resulting in a higher dynamic load capacity than caged bearings of the same size. The bearing is manufactured from durable bearing steel by Nadella. Made from a thin sheet steel, the outer ring is drawn (deep drawn) to create a cost-effective, space-saving bearing design. Material : It is manufactured from high-quality bearing steel to ensure durability and resistance to wear. Features are : High Radial Stiffness, Compactness, Cost-effective maintenance, Pure Radial Load Support, Minimised Friction. Applications : Gearboxes and pumps, Conveyor system, Textile and printing presses, Power tools, Robotics, Automotive transmissions, Off-road and agricultural machinery.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing.

subName: Double Row Tapered Roller Bearing Plain Cup Type
desc: SUPER PRECISION DOUBLE ROW TAPERED ROLLER BEARING PLAIN CUP (G TYPE)
tech: DOUBLE ROW BEARINGS PLAIN CUP (G TYPE) The plain outer race enables this bearing to be used in a ‘floating’ position to permit thermal expansion. As such it can replace a P type bearing when additional load capacity is required. G type bearings can be preadjusted to give GE double row bearings. This is achieved by fitting a spacer between the inner races to give the required assembly end play or preload. The choice of setting is based upon a number of parameters such as speed, lubrication and applied loads. Double row bearings offer nearly twice the capacity of the equivalent single row bearing, and are therefore used in more heavily loaded applications.

tech: DOUBLE ROW BEARINGS PLAIN CUP (G TYPE) The plain outer race enables this bearing to be used in a ‘floating’ position to permit thermal expansion. As such it can replace a P type bearing when additional load capacity is required. G type bearings can be preadjusted to give GE double row bearings. This is achieved by fitting a spacer between the inner races to give the required assembly end play or preload. The choice of setting is based upon a number of parameters such as speed, lubrication and applied loads. Double row bearings offer nearly twice the capacity of the equivalent single row bearing, and are therefore used in more heavily loaded applications.

As such it can replace a P type bearing when additional load capacity is required. G type bearings can be preadjusted to give GE double row bearings. This is achieved by fitting a spacer between the inner races to give the required assembly end play or preload. The choice of setting is based upon a number of parameters such as speed, lubrication and applied loads. Double row bearings offer nearly twice the capacity of the equivalent single row bearing, and are therefore used in more heavily loaded applications.

tech: CARB toroidal roller bearings are unique as well as accommodating misalignment without increased stress levels, they also provide frictionless axial movement within the bearing in the non-locating position in self-aligning bearing arrangements. Being SKF Explorer bearings, they can accommodate higher load levels and provide significantly extended service life. Features are : Accommodate misalignment and axial displacement within the bearing, High radial load carrying capacity. Provide frictionless axial movement, Reduce noise and vibration levels. Application.: Industrial Transmissions, Pulp & Paper Industry, Marine & Construction Machinery, Industrial Fans & Blowers. K=Tapered Bore, Taper 1:12, TN9=Injection Moulded Window-Type Cage Of Glass Fibre Reinforced Polyamide 4,6, Roller Centered.

These bearing is a highly specialized drawn cup needle roller bearing designed with an open end. Manufactured by INA, this component features a thin-walled, outer ring paired with a comprehensive needle roller assembly. It is engineered to provide maximum load capacity within exceptionally tight, radially compact machinery spaces. Material : High-grade, case-hardened sheet steel for the outer ring, high-carbon chromium steel for the rollers, and stamped sheet steel for the internal cage. Features are : Ultra-Compact Cross Section, Direct-Shaft Raceway Compatibility, Low Mass Inertia, High Shock Absorption Profile, High Rotational Stability, Enhanced Logarithmic Profiling, Elevated Thermal Thresholds, Through-Lubrication Optimization, Friction Minimization. Applications : Industrial Printing Presses, Hydraulic & Power Transmission Units, Heavy Off-Highway & Construction Machinery, Robotics & Factory Automation Systems, Marine Propulsion & Deck Infrastructure, Agriculture Equipment. HV=Heat Treatment.

desc: SINGLE ROW SPHERICAL ROLLER WITH TAPERED BORE
tech: The McGill SB..KW33SS series is a single-row, sealed spherical roller bearing with a tapered bore. This design, part of the SPHERE-ROL series, is built for high loads and exceptional tolerance to misalignment in demanding industrial applications. Designed to handle radial loads and moderate axial loads (in both directions) while accommodating shaft misalignment and shaft deflection. Material : Bearing steel 52100 (standard high‐carbon chromium steel). Features are : Misalignment Capability, Reduced Maintenance, High Speed Operation, Exceptional Resistance to Shock and Vibration, Cost Savings through Integration, Reduced Friction, Increased, Fatigue Life, Optimized for Harsh Environments. Applications : Construction and Mining Equipment, Agricultural Equipment, Material Handling, Conveyor Systems, Pulp and Paper Industry, Steel and Metal Processing Mills, Power Generation, Industrial Gearboxes, Electric Motors and Generators. K=Tapered Bore, Taper 1:12. W33=Lubrication Groove And Three Holes In Bearing Outer Ring, SS=Double NYLAPLATE Seals.

desc: SINGLE ROW SPHERICAL ROLLER WITH TAPERED BORE
tech: The McGill SB..KW33YSS series is a single-row, sealed spherical roller bearing with a tapered bore. It belongs to the SPHERE-ROL series manufactured by McGill. It is designed for demanding industrial applications that require high load capacity and the ability to accommodate misalignment. A single row of large, spherical rolling elements gives this bearing a higher dynamic load capacity than comparable double-row versions. Material : 52100 bearing steel. desc: SINGLE ROW SPHERICAL ROLLER WITH TAPERED BORE
tech: The McGill SB..KW33TSSVA bearing is a premium single-row sealed spherical roller bearing, part of the high-performance SPHERE-ROL series. It\'s design is specifically tailored for heavy-duty industrial applications operating in high-temperature environments. The spherical design of the outer ring raceway allows the bearing to accommodate angular misalignment and shaft deflections, improving reliability in various applications. Materials : The bearing rings and rolling elements are made from 52100 bearing steel, and it features a steel cage. Features are : Self-Aligning Capability, Increased load capacity, Improved Reliability, Reduced Maintenance Costs. Applications : Pulp and paper mills, Steel mills and foundries, Power generation plants, Material handling systems, Marine applications. K=Tapered Bore, Taper 1:12, W33=Lubrication Groove And Three Holes In Bearing Outer Ring, TSS : Twin (double) Standard Seals. These are high-temperature seals that prevent contamination and retain lubricant, VA : High-Temperature Grease & Seals.

desc: SINGLE ROW SPHERICAL ROLLER WITH TAPERED BORE
tech: The McGill SB...KC3W33SS series is a single-row sealed spherical roller bearing. This SPHERE-ROL type bearing is designed to handle high radial and moderate axial loads while accommodating misalignment. The spherical design allows the bearing to compensate for shaft misalignment and housing angle errors, reducing stress and extending service life. Material : Made from 52100 bearing steel with a steel cage. Features are : High Load Capacity, Self-Alignment, High Speeds & Loads, Contamination Protection, Reduced Maintenance, Enhanced Misalignment Capability, High Temperature Range. Applications : Pulp and paper mills, Construction and mining equipment, Material handling systems (conveyors, cranes), Reduction gears, Agricultural machinery, Electric motors and generators. K=Tapered Bore, Taper 1:12. W33=Lubrication Groove And Three Holes In Bearing Outer Ring, SS=double NYLAPLATE Seals, C3=Internal Clearance more then Normal.

desc: SINGLE ROW SPHERICAL ROLLER WITH TAPERED BORE
tech: The McGill SB..KC3W33YSS series is a single-row spherical roller bearing manufactured by McGill. This bearing has a tapered bore, a double seal for protection, and includes a lubrication groove and holes on the outer ring. The single-row spherical roller bearing is designed for high radial and moderate axial loads. It\'s single-row spherical design allows the bearing to accommodate angular misalignment of the shaft relative to the housing. This reduces stress and extends the bearing\'s life in situations where perfect alignment is difficult to maintain. Material : The bearing is constructed from 52100 bearing steel. Features are : Increased Dynamic Load Capacity, Longer Fatigue Life, Superior Misalignment Capability, Protection in Harsh Environments, Lubricant Retention, Reduced Maintenance.Applications : Crushers and Mining Equipment, Conveyor Systems, Industrial Gearboxes, Pumps and Compressors, Pulp and Paper Mills, Steel Mills and Metal Processing, Wind Turbines, Agricultural Equipment, Industrial Fans and Blowers. K=Tapered Bore, Taper 1:12.W33=Lubrication Groove And Three Holes In Bearing Outer Ring, YSS=LAMBDA-Seals, C3=Internal Clearance Larger Than Normal.

This bearing has a tapered bore, a double seal for protection, and includes a lubrication groove and holes on the outer ring. The single-row spherical roller bearing is designed for high radial and moderate axial loads. It\'s single-row spherical design allows the bearing to accommodate angular misalignment of the shaft relative to the housing. This reduces stress and extends the bearing\'s life in situations where perfect alignment is difficult to maintain. Material : The bearing is constructed from 52100 bearing steel. Features are : Increased Dynamic Load Capacity, Longer Fatigue Life, Superior Misalignment Capability, Protection in Harsh Environments, Lubricant Retention, Reduced Maintenance.Applications : Crushers and Mining Equipment, Conveyor Systems, Industrial Gearboxes, Pumps and Compressors, Pulp and Paper Mills, Steel Mills and Metal Processing, Wind Turbines, Agricultural Equipment, Industrial Fans and Blowers. subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and no flanges on the inner ring, NU design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in both directions. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC=Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, M=Two-Piece Machined Brass Cage, Roller Centered, P64=Combination Of P6 (Dimensional And Running Accuracy To ISO Tolerance Class 6 (Better Than Normal)) And C4 (Bearing Internal Clearance Greater Than C3), VA301=(Segment Precision, Code 31)=Bearing For Railway Vehicle Traction Motors.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single-row cylindrical roller bearing with cage. This bearing consists of a solid inner and outer ring with cylindrical rollers in a cage. This cage prevents contact between the cylinder rollers, so this bearing type can support higher speeds than full-complement cylinder roller bearings. Also, single-row cylindrical roller bearings with cages are very rigid and they can take high radial forces. As the inner and outer rings of these bearings can be easily disassembled, they are very easy to install. Applications of single-row cylindrical roller bearings include gearboxes, agricultural machinery, pumps, compressors, and electric motors. The outer ring of this bearing has two rigid ribs, while the inner ring has none. This bearing type is commonly used as a floating bearing. Floating bearings allow axial displacement of the shaft relative to the housing in both directions. subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: These bearing is a single-row cylindrical roller bearing with cage. This bearing consists of a solid inner and outer ring with cylindrical rollers in a cage. This cage prevents contact between the cylinder rollers, so this bearing type can support higher speeds than full-complement cylinder roller bearings. Also, single-row cylindrical roller bearings with cages are very rigid and they can take high radial forces. As the inner and outer rings of these bearings can be easily disassembled, they are very easy to install. Applications of single-row cylindrical roller bearings include gearboxes, agricultural machinery, pumps, compressors, and electric motors. The outer ring of this bearing has two rigid ribs, while the inner ring has none. As a result, NU bearings are only capable of supporting radial forces. Floating bearings allow axial displacement of the shaft relative to the housing in both directions. Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and one on the inner ring, NJ design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in one direction. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In One Direction, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Large Compressors and Pumps, Power Generation Equipment, Metal Processing and Rolling Mills, Mining and Quarrying Machinery, Pulp and Paper Processing Mills, Oil and Gas Drilling Equipment, Construction Machinery. MA= Two-Piece Machined Brass Cage, Outer Ring Centered, C3=Internal Clearance Larger Than Normal.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single-row cylindrical roller bearing with cage. This bearing consists of a solid inner and outer ring with cylindrical rollers in a cage. This cage prevents contact between the cylinder rollers, so this bearing type can support higher speeds than full-complement cylinder roller bearings. Also, single-row cylindrical roller bearings with cages are very rigid and they can take high radial forces. As the inner and outer rings of these bearings can be easily disassembled, they are very easy to install. Applications of single-row cylindrical roller bearings include gearboxes, agricultural machinery, pumps, compressors, and electric motors. The outer ring has two rigid ribs, while the inner ring has one rigid rib. This bearing type is used as a support bearing. Support bearings allow axial displacement of the shaft relative to the housing in one direction. The shaft is located axially in the other direction. NJ bearings can also be used as locating bearings by combining them with HJ angle rings (available separately). Locating bearings are used to locate a shaft axially in both directions. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, PA= Glass Fibre Reinforced PA66 Cage, Outer Ring Centered, C5H= Internal Play Upper Half C5 Range.

CARB toroidal roller bearings are unique as well as accommodating misalignment without increased stress levels, they also provide frictionless axial movement within the bearing in the non-locating position in self-aligning bearing arrangements. Being SKF Explorer bearings, they can accommodate higher load levels and provide significantly extended service life. Features are :  Accommodate misalignment and axial displacement within the bearing, High radial load carrying capacity, Provide frictionless axial movement, Reduce noise and vibration levels, Long bearing system life. Application : Industrial Fans and Blowers, Pulp and Paper Machinery, Industrial Transmissions & Gearboxes, Electric Motors, Conveyor Systems & Mining Automotive Systems. Cylindrical roller bearings Without Outer Ring
desc: Double Row Full Complement Cylindrical Roller Bearings
tech: Type C : One Side Rings. Double row full complement cylindrical roller bearings feature solid inner and outer rings, as well as rolling elements properly guided between ribs. The double-row cylindrical roller bearings have a high load capacity due to the high number of cylindrical rollers in each row, and the proprietary optimized roller ring profile that results in the best load distribution. Double-row bearings feature a lubrication groove and a lubrication hole in the middle of the outer ring.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and no flanges on the inner ring, NU design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in both directions. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design. Applications: Machine Tool Spindles, Power Generation Equipment, Metal Processing and Rolling Mills, Mining and Quarrying Machinery, Pulp and Paper Processing Mills, Construction Machinery. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, ML= One-Piece Form-Turned Window-Type Brass Cage, Inner Or Outer Ring Centered, P63= Combination Of P6 (Dimensional And Running Accuracy To ISO Tolerance Class 6 Better Than Normal, C3R= Radial Internal Clearance Between Upper Part Of Normal And Lower Part Of C3.

Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and no flanges on the inner ring, NU design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in both directions. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design. Applications : Large Rotating Electrical Machinery, Fluid Handling & Air Compression, Machine Tooling & Metalworking, Pumps & Compressors, Wind & Renewable Power Generation, Paper and Printing Machinery. ML=One-Piece Form-Turned Window-Type Brass Cage, Inner Or Outer Ring Centered, W64=(Segment Precision, Code W6)=Solid Oil Filling.

tech: These bearing is a highly specialized, heavy-duty single-row cylindrical roller bearing engineered to sustain exceptionally high radial loads in high-speed, high-vibration applications. It commonly designates localized profile optimizations on the roller track or targeted housing modifications to promote uniform load sharing and prevent edge-stress concentration. It featurestwo integral flanges on the outer ring and no flanges on the inner ring. This allows the bearing to accommodate axial displacement of the shaft relative to the housing in both directions. Features are : Logarithmic Roller Profile, Non-Locating Axial Flexibility, Separable Component Design, High Rigidity Profile, Super-Finished Raceways, Rapid Lubrication Film Formation, Stabilized Heat Treatment. Applications : Industrial Gearboxes, Mining, Quarrying & Construction Equipment, Metal Processing Equipment, Pumps & Compressors, Power Generation & Energy Sector, Pulp, Paper & Chemical Processing, Material Handling. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC=Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, M=Two-Piece Machined Brass Cage, Roller Centered, C3=Internal Clearance Larger Than Normal.

It featuring a two integral flanges on the outer ring and no flanges on the inner ring. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design. Applications : Wind Turbine Generators, Machine Tool Spindles, Industrial Gearboxes, Paper and Pulp Machinery, Centrifugal Pumps & Compressors, Material Handling & Mining, Industrial Blowers & Fans. EC=Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, J=Pressed Steel Cage, Roller Centered, Unhardened, C3L=Reduced Clearance Range Corresponding To The Lower Half Of The Actual Clearance Range.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: These bearing is a highly specialized, heavy-duty single-row cylindrical roller bearing engineered to sustain exceptionally high radial loads in high-speed, high-vibration applications. subName: Cylindrical roller bearings Without Outer Ring
tech: These bearing is a industrial-grade double-row cylindrical roller bearing without an outer ring. This bearing lacks a traditional outer steel ring. Instead, the dual rows of cylindrical rollers run directly against a hardened, precision-ground bore within your machinery\'s housing. This design saves critical radial space and reduces component weight. It features no retaining cage between the rollers. Maximizing the number of rolling elements provides the highest possible radial load rating in this footprint. Material : Manufactured from premium, through-hardened carbon-chromium bearing steel (100Cr6 / SAE 52100) for exceptional wear resistance and structural fatigue life. Features are : Non-Separable Assembly, Exceptional Shock Resistance, Axial Displacement Permissibility, High Rotational Stability, Low Initial Starting Torque, Excellent Vibration Damping. Applications : Construction & Mining Equipment, Renewable Energy & Power Generation, Printing Machinery, Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment. RNN=Double-Row Radial Cylindrical Roller Bearing Without an Outer Ring.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing. Q : TQ-Line Execution.

Combined bearings like the RAX Series are designed to simultaneously support both radial and axial loads on a shaft. They comprise a needle thrust bearing and needle cage retained in a common outer ring. The technical characteristics of the thrust bearing and the needle cage are set out in the appropriate sections. These bearings form one integral unit permitting easy storage, handling and fitting. Their high radial and axial load capacities and small space requirement enable cost effective solutions to be achieved. The bearings can be used without inner rings or thrust plates, if the shaft journals serving as raceways are of sufficient hardness and possess a suitable surface finish.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing. B : Steeper Contact Angle Than Standard Design, J2 : Pressed Steel Window-Type Cage, Q : Optimized Contact Geometry And Surface Finish, CL7C : High-Performance Design For Pinion Bearing Arrangements.

These bearing is a combined needle roller bearing designed by INA. It functions as a complete, single-bearing assembly engineered to handle both multi-directional load configurations and severe operational stress within tight mechanical footprints. Integrates a radial needle roller and cage assembly alongside an axial component (ball or cylindrical thrust system). This dual-action design supports high radial forces and single-direction axial thrust simultaneously. Material : Through-hardened 100Cr6 carbon-chromium steel rings and rollers with a lightweight, glass-fibre reinforced polyamide 66 cage. Features are : Axial Load Accommodation, High Limiting Speed, Low Initial Friction Torque, Simplified Maintenance, Space-Saving Geometry, Extended Service Life, Broad Operating Temperature Envelope, Zero Angular Misalignment Tolerance. Applications : Textile & Printing Machinery, Construction Machinery, Food & Pharmaceutical Packaging Machinery, Agricultural Equipment. NKIB=Combined Needle Roller and Angular Contact Ball Bearing.

The McGill Multi-Rol RS series is a heavy-duty, single-row, full-complement needle roller bearing known for its high radial load capacity in a compact design. This bearing is a machined-race needle roller bearing, which means it has a robust outer ring capable of handling heavy shock loads, unlike drawn-cup bearings.  It features a full complement of needle rollers (no cage or retainer), which maximizes the number of rolling elements and thus provides the highest possible radial load capacity for its size. Material : Made from 52100 bearing steel. Features are :  Integrated Inner Ring, High Load Capacity, Relubrication Capability, Wide Operating Temperature Range, Maintenance Friendly, Cost-Effective Assembly. Applications : Automotive Transmissions and Engines, Industrial Gearboxes, Pumps and Compressors, Heavy Machinery, Material Handling, Textile and Printing Machinery, Power Tools, Steel Mills.

MR series CAGEROL bearings are interchangeable dimensionally with all heavy-duty needle bearings. They are available with or without separable inner races. Cage type CAGEROL bearings from McGill are designed especially to meet the performance requirements of applications where greater shaft misalignment and higher speeds exceed the capabilities of ordinary full complement needle roller bearings. Features Are : Radial space is limited. Maximum radial load rating within space limitation is required. Higher speeds are present. Greater misalignment is present, Lower internal friction is required. Greater lubrication reservoir is required.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and one on the inner ring, NJF design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in one direction. A retaining ring on the inner ring provides a shoulder to hold the bearing components in place. The retaining ring should not be loaded axially during operation. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In One Direction, Separable Design, High-Speed Rating, Low Vibration Profile. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction, Industrial Gearboxes & Transmissions, Mining, Mineral, and Cement Infrastructure, Renewable Energy and Power Generation,  Metalworking, Stamping, and Machining. A=Optimized Internal Design.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and one on the inner ring, NJ design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in one direction. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In One Direction, Separable Design. Applications : Wind Turbine Generators, Machine Tool Spindles, Industrial Gearboxes, Paper and Pulp Machinery, Centrifugal Pumps & Compressors, Material Handling & Mining, Industrial Blowers & Fans. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, P= Injection Moulded Cage Of Glass Fibre Reinforced Polyamide 6,6, Roller Centered, C4=Bearing Internal Clearance Greater Than C3.

These bearing is a high-precision machined needle roller bearing with an inner ring manufactured by INA. It provides extreme structural rigidity and resists heavy deformation under high radial forces. This allows the inner ring, the outer ring, and the cage assembly to be mounted independently, vastly simplifying assembly and maintenance workflows. The rolling elements feature advanced logarithmic profiling. This subtle curvature at the tips of the needles prevents stress concentrations (edge stresses) during minor shaft misalignments or heavy deflections. Material : High-strength precision chrome alloy steel (typically 100Cr6) with a durable steel or polyamide cage. Features are : Compact Cross-Section, Superfinished Raceways, Low Frictional Torque, High Acceleration Capability, Thermal & Environmental Resilience, Bi-Directional Axial Displacement, Logarithmic Profile Rollers. Applications : Construction & Agricultural Machinery, CNC Machine Tool Spindles, Textile Processing Machinery, Printing & Paper Presses, Aerospace, Defense & Marine Subsystems, Renewable Energy, Metal Rolling and Slitting Mills, Packaging Machinery, Woodworking Machinery. NA=Needle Roller Bearing With a Removable Ground Inner Ring.

subName: Cylindrical roller bearings Without Outer Ring
tech: These bearing is a high-precision, single-row radial cylindrical roller bearing without an inner ring manufactured by INA. Unlike standard ball bearings, its internal rollers feature linear contact with the raceways. This distributes stresses evenly and yields exceptionally high radial load-carrying capabilities. Features a modified, open separable design that allows independent installation and effortless removal of the inner and outer rings during drivetrain maintenance. Material : The bearing features high-grade chrome steel (100Cr6) rings and rollers with a glass-fiber reinforced polyamide (PA66-GF25) cage. Features are : High-Capacity Load Rating, Logarithmic Roller Profile, High-Speed Boundary Dynamics, Non-Locating Axial Tolerance, High Operational Rigidity, Simplified Assembly Integration, Martensitic Heat Treatment, Low Residual Stress, High Thermal Limits. Applications : Construction Machinery, Agricultural Equipment, Material Handling Systems, Renewable Energy Systems, Metal Rolling Mills, Industrial Printing Presses, Paper Processing Plants, Fluid Handling & Power Generation, Industrial Gearboxes & Reduction Units.

Applications : Textile Looms and Weaving Equipment, Agricultural Equipment, Earthmoving Equipment, Printing Presses, Paper and Pulp Processing Mills, Material Handling Cranes & Hoists, Packaging Machines. subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing. J2 : Pressed Steel Window-Type Cage, VE197 : Guide Flange Ground For Use With A Shield.

This is an single row cylindrical roller bearing manufactured by the brand RHP. Designed to carry heavy radial loads due to the line contact between the rollers and raceways. The RHP MRJ is a premium, single-row imperial cylindrical roller bearing primarily designed to support heavy radial loads. Manufactured by RHP, this heavy-duty bearing features two integral flanges on the inner ring and a smooth, flangeless outer ring, allowing for axial displacement (free-end alignment).  The inner ring (with the roller assembly) and the outer ring are completely detachable from each other, which simplifies mounting and alignment during installation. Material : Constructed from through-hardened, high-purity carbon-chromium steel (SAE 52100 equivalent) to ensure maximum wear and fatigue resistance. Features are : High Radial Rigidity, Shock Absorption, Thermal Expansion Management, Low Friction Coefficients, Lubrication Maintenance, Super-Finished Raceways, High-Speed Performance, High Heat Capability. Applications : Electrical Equipment & Power Generation, Fluid Handling & Compression Systems, Conveyor Systems & Materials Handling, Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, Machine Tools & Spindles, Paper, Printing, & Rolling Mills.

The RHP LLRJ is a single-row cylindrical roller bearing. It is designed with a two-lipped outer ring and a separate inner ring. This bearing handles very heavy radial loads in tight spaces. Utilizes modified line contact between the rollers and raceways. This profile distributes stress evenly and prevents edge-loading, giving it a much higher radial load capacity than a standard ball bearing of the same size. The inner ring can be completely separated from the outer ring and roller assembly. Material : Manufactured from high-purity, through-hardened carbon chromium steel for uniform strength and maximum wear resistance. Features are : High Operational Temperature Threshold, Easier Maintenance, Vibration Dampening, Separable Components, Low Heat Generation, High Radial Capacity, Axial Displacement Capability, High-Speed Suitability. Applications : Electric Motors and Generators, Heavy-Duty Pumps and Compressors, Conveyor and Material Handling Equipment, Transport, Rail & Marine Systems, Industrial Blowers and HVAC Fans, Agricultural & Construction Machinery, Woodworking & Paper Production Mill Assemblies,

The MMRJ RHP is a heavy-duty, single-row cylindrical roller bearing produced by RHP. It is engineered to deliver high precision and carry substantial radial loads in space-restricted or high-velocity industrial machinery. The double-prefix modifier specifies advanced thrust-management features. The outer ring is machined with two integral retaining ribs (lips), and the inner ring includes a stabilizing shoulder. This traps the roller sequence to offer rigid axial locating capabilities in addition to radial performance. Material : It is made from high-carbon chromium bearing steel that is premium-grade and heat-stabilized. Features are :  High-Speed Suitability, Logarithmic Roller Profiling, Superfinished Raceways, Rigid Axial Guidance, Thermal Range Stability, Maintenance & Installation Features, Acoustic Noise Dampening. Applications : Pumps and Compressors, Electric Motors & Generators, Textile Machinery, Material Handling Conveyors, Agricultural Equipment, Machine Tool Spindles, Paper Processing Machinery, Industrial Fans & Blowers, Marine, Aerospace & Transport Equipment, Mining, Quarrying & Construction Infrastructure.

It is engineered to deliver high precision and carry substantial radial loads in space-restricted or high-velocity industrial machinery. The double-prefix modifier specifies advanced thrust-management features. The outer ring is machined with two integral retaining ribs (lips), and the inner ring includes a stabilizing shoulder. This traps the roller sequence to offer rigid axial locating capabilities in addition to radial performance. Material : It is made from high-carbon chromium bearing steel that is premium-grade and heat-stabilized. Features are :  High-Speed Suitability, Logarithmic Roller Profiling, Superfinished Raceways, Rigid Axial Guidance, Thermal Range Stability, Maintenance & Installation Features, Acoustic Noise Dampening. Applications : Pumps and Compressors, Electric Motors & Generators, Textile Machinery, Material Handling Conveyors, Agricultural Equipment, Machine Tool Spindles, Paper Processing Machinery, Industrial Fans & Blowers, Marine, Aerospace & Transport Equipment, Mining, Quarrying & Construction Infrastructure.

The MRJA bearing is a specialized, large-scale, heavy-duty single-row cylindrical roller bearing. Manufacturer by RHP, this bearing is uniquely designed to sustain exceptional radial load configurations while offering restricted, one-directional axial tracking. The inner assembly (inner ring, roller elements, and cage) can be cleanly separated from the outer ring during installation. This feature dramatically simplifies housing press-fits, equipment maintenance, and system alignment inspections. Material : It is made from high-purity, through-hardened carbon chromium steel for maximum wear and fatigue resistance. Features are : High Radial Load Capacity, Semi-Locating Design, Controlled Thermal Expansion Accommodation, Super-Finished Rolling Elements, Open Configuration, Low Heat Generation, Low Vibration & Noise, Axial Displacement Flexibility. Applications : Machine Tool Spindles, Electric Motors & Generators, Pumps & Compressors, Marine Propulsion & Auxiliary Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, Material Handling & Mining Machinery, Air Handling & Fan Systems, Printing, Paper & Textile Mills.

The LRJA is a premium, single-row cylindrical roller bearing manufactured by RHP. It is engineered to support high radial loads in heavy industrial machinery, gearboxes, and pumps. Features two integral flanges on the inner ring and one flange on the outer ring. This configuration allows the bearing to provide axial location and carry light or intermittent thrust loads in one direction, unlike the standard LRJ series which has no flanges on the outer ring. Material : It is manufactured from high-purity, through-hardened chrome carbon steel for maximum wear resistance and fatigue life. Features are : Logarithmic Roller Crowning, Super-Finished Raceways, High-Speed and Vibration Performance, Open Configuration, Rotational Speed Ratings, Low Starting Torque, Axial Displacement Limit, Operating Temperature. Applications : Electric Motors & Generators, Textile & Paper Mill Machinery, Conveyor Drive Systems, Machine Tools & Spindles, Rail, Marine, and Maritime Engineering, Mining, Quarrying, and Mineral Processing, Industrial Blowers and Turbo Fans.

Material : It is manufactured from high-purity, through-hardened chrome carbon steel for maximum wear resistance and fatigue life. The XLRJ is an single-row cylindrical roller bearing manufactured by RHP. It is engineered to support exceptionally high radial loads while allowing for axial movement or thermal expansion. The XLRJ design signifies two integral flanges on the inner ring and an outer ring with no flanges. This profile permits the housing and outer components to float axially in either direction relative to the shaft. The outer ring can be fully slid off from the inner ring assembly. Material : It is made of through-hardened, high-carbon chromium steel (GCr15/52100) for maximum wear resistance and structural fatigue life. Features are : Line Contact Geometry, High-Speed Stability, Accommodates Thermal Expansion, Open Configuration Efficiency, Low Assembly Interference, Axial Displacement, Shock Resistance, Easy Installation, High Power Density, Low Starting Torque. Applications : Electric Motors and Generators, Centrifugal Pumps and Compressors, Machine Tool Spindles, Printing Presses and Paper Mills,Conveyor Systems and Fan Drives, Textile Manufacturing Machinery, Aerospace, Maritime, and Defense.

desc: Cylindrical Roller Bearing Current-Insulating Bearing NU234E/M6/C3/SQ77
tech: E-M6-C3-SQ77) E=Increased Load Capacity. M6=Roller Guided Solid Brass Cage For Cylindrical Roller Bearings, Cage Body Designed With Trapezoid-Shaped Machined Rivets. C3=Internal Clearance Larger Than Normal. SQ77=(Segment Precision, Code VL)=Isolated Up To 500 Volt.

subName: Double Direction Taper Roller Bearing Units
tech: Double-row taper roller bearings can carry radial loads and double-direction axial loads. The clearance of the double-row taper roller bearings have to be adjusted properly before delivery. They can be mounted and used directly without adjusting again. Double-row taper roller bearings can limit the displacement in both directions on the shaft to housing in the range of axial clearance.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: These bearing is a highly specialized, precision-engineered single-row cylindrical roller bearing designed primarily for extreme-duty applications, most notably railway locomotive traction motors and heavy industrial gearboxes. Material : The bearing is made of high-carbon chromium steel (SAE 52100 / GCr15) for maximum wear resistance, paired with a heavy-duty machined brass cage to withstand intense operational vibrations. subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single-row cylindrical roller bearing with cage. This bearing consists of a solid inner and outer ring with cylindrical rollers in a cage. This cage prevents contact between the cylinder rollers, so this bearing type can support higher speeds than full-complement cylinder roller bearings. Also, Single-row cylindrical roller bearings with cages are very rigid and they can take high radial forces. As the inner and outer rings of these bearings can be easily disassembled, they are very easy to install. Applications of Single-row cylindrical roller bearings include gearboxes, agricultural machinery, pumps, compressors, and electric motors. The outer ring has two rigid ribs, while the inner ring has one rigid rib. Support bearings allow axial displacement of the shaft relative to the housing in one direction. The shaft is located axially in the other direction. Locating bearings are used to locate a shaft axially in both directions. TN= Injection Molded Plastic Cage. Alternative Designs And/Or Material Are Identified By An Added Figure, VA820= Bearing For Railway Axle Boxes According To En 12080: 1998, Class 1.

desc: DRAWN CUP ROLLER BEARING WITH OPEN END
tech: The Nadella DB bearing is a specific model of drawn cup needle roller bearing, notable for its compact, full-complement design which maximizes load capacity in applications where radial space is limited. This bearing consists of a thin, heat-treated steel drawn outer cup that encloses a full complement of needle rollers (without a cage). The needles are retained by their ends or by grease, and this design choice allows for more rolling elements than a caged design, directly contributing to its high radial load capacity. Material: Made from high-quality steel (bearing steel) for durability and resistance to wear and tear. Features are : High Load Handling, Space-Saving, Reliable Performance, Lightweight, Ease of Mounting, Cost-Effectiveness, Minimal Friction. Applications : Transmissions and Gearboxes, Pumps and Compressors, Presses and Conveyors, Textile Machinery, Agricultural Equipment, Packaging Machinery, Power Tools.

desc: DRAWN CUP ROLLER BEARING WITH CLOSED END
tech: The DBF bearing is a full complement drawn cup needle roller bearing with a closed end, designed for high radial loads in compact, space-limited applications. The bearing is designed to be press-fitted into a housing, where the housing bore serves as the outer raceway. The bearing has a thin-walled, deep-drawn outer ring that is closed at one end, which effectively seals off the end of a shaft from contaminants and prevents injury from a rotating shaft. It is a full complement design, meaning it uses the maximum possible number of needle rollers without a cage, which provides an extremely high load-carrying capacity. It is a pure radial bearing and can support high radial forces, but it is not suitable for supporting axial loads or compensating for angular misalignments. Material : The bearing is generally made from high-quality bearing steel, providing long-lasting resistance to wear and tear. Applications : Automotive transmissions and gearboxes, Industrial machinery such as presses and conveyors, General systems requiring a compact, cost-effective bearing arrangement.

Material : Standard versions are made from high-carbon chromium bearing steel (GCr15/Chrome steel). subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: The NF...M RHP is a high-capacity, single-row cylindrical roller bearing manufactured by RHP. It features a machined brass cage and is uniquely designed to support heavy radial forces while managing light, unidirectional axial thrust loads. The inner ring has two integral flanges, while the outer ring has only one. This permits the bearing to guide and locate a shaft axially in one direction only. The outer ring can be completely separated from the inner ring assembly on one side. This makes mounting, dismounting, and maintenance significantly easier during machinery assembly. Features are : Controlled Axial Displacement, Vibration and Shock Resistance, Low Friction & Heat Reduction, Corrosion Resistance, Optimized Roller Profiles,Thermal Expansion Accommodation, High-Speed Guidance. Applications : Electric Motors & Generators, Compressors & Centrifugal Pumps, Paper Mills & Steel Rolling Mills, Mining, Quarrying, & Aggregate Processing, Wind Energy & Renewable Power Generation, Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Material Handling & Conveyor Systems. M=Machined Brass Cage, Located On The Rolling Elements.
