subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single-row cylindrical roller bearing with cage. This bearing consists of a solid inner and outer ring with cylindrical rollers in a cage. This cage prevents contact between the cylinder rollers, so this bearing type can support higher speeds than full-complement cylinder roller bearings. Single-row cylindrical roller bearings with cages are very rigid and they can take high radial forces. As the inner and outer rings of these bearings can be easily disassembled, they are very easy to install. Applications of Single-row cylindrical roller bearings include gearboxes, agricultural machinery, pumps, compressors, and electric motors. The outer ring of this bearing has two rigid ribs, while the inner ring has none. Floating bearings allow axial displacement of the shaft relative to the housing in both directions. This is necessary in applications where the shaft material shrinks or expands due to temperature changes thermal expansion. Support bearings can support radial forces and also axial forces in a Single direction. tech: SKF is a single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing. subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing. B : Steeper Contact Angle Than Standard Design, J2 : Pressed Steel Window-Type Cage, Q : Optimized Contact Geometry And Surface Finish.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and one on the inner ring, NJ design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in one direction. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In One Direction, Separable Design. Applications : Wind Turbine Generators, Machine Tool Spindles, Industrial Gearboxes, Paper and Pulp Machinery, Centrifugal Pumps & Compressors, Material Handling & Mining, Industrial Blowers & Fans. EC=Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, P=Injection Moulded Cage Of Glass Fibre Reinforced Polyamide 6,6, Roller Centered, C4= Bearing Internal Clearance Greater Than C3, VQ015= Inner Ring With Crowned Raceway For Increased Permissible Misalignment.

166-1012 TNG  OR FŁT 020 OR CPM2573  Bearing of travel final drive usually is angular contact. They task is to minimize the friction resistance during work of the planetary gearbox. Bearings installed in excavators of 1.5-50 tone weight are usually divided into two types. These are tapered roller bearings and angular contact bearings.

The angular contactor /166-1012/ bearing is constructed in such a way that the

inner and outer tracks of the bearing are asymmetrically positioned. This is to reduce the working area of ​​the reducers and increase the pressure resistance. There are two types of angular-contact bearings in excavators: single-row and double-row.

subName: Cylindrical roller bearings Without Outer Ring
desc: Single Row Full Complement Cylindrical Roller Bearings
tech: Type A : Without Flange Rings. Roller and needle roller bearings can withstand only radial loads, even very strong ones, with moderate rotational speeds. To make maximum use of the available space, cylindrical roller bearings with one or more full-fill crowns are made. They can have special coatings, e.g., chrome, phosphating, galvanizing, or black oxide. They are made of typical chromium bearing steel, either full hardening or case hardening. Main Applilcations : Planetary gearboxes, textile machines.

tech: 166-1012 TNG  OR FŁT 020 OR CPM2573 Bearing of travel final drive usually is angular contact. They task is to minimize the friction resistance during work of the planetary gearbox. Bearings installed in excavators of 1.5-50 tone weight are usually divided into two types. These are tapered roller bearings and angular contact bearings. The angular contactor /166-1012/ bearing is constructed in such a way that the inner and outer tracks of the bearing are asymmetrically positioned. This is to reduce the working area of ​​the reducers and increase the pressure resistance. There are two types of angular-contact bearings in excavators: single-row and double-row.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. Having two integral flanges on the outer ring and no flanges on the inner ring, NU design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in both directions. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design. Applications: Electric Motors, Machine Tool Spindles, Automotive Alternators, Heavy Duty Machinery & Construction. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, MRD= To Enable Easier Handling During Maintenance, A One-Piece Machined Brass Cage Is Fitted That Is Roller And Outer Shoulder Guided And Has A Roller-Drop Function, C5= Bearing Internal Clearance Greater Than C4, VA378= Application Oriented Variants.

subName: Cylindrical roller bearings Without Outer Ring
desc: Double Row Full Complement Cylindrical Roller Bearings
tech: Type A : Two Flange Rings + One Snap Rings. Double row full complement cylindrical roller bearings feature solid inner and outer rings, as well as rolling elements properly guided between ribs. The double-row cylindrical roller bearings have a high load capacity due to the high number of cylindrical rollers in each row, and the proprietary optimized roller ring profile that results in the best load distribution. Double-row bearings feature a lubrication groove and a lubrication hole in the middle of the outer ring.

Single row IBC cylindrical roller bearings with cage are manufactured in the designs NU, N, NJ and NUP. Cylindrical roller bearings of the design N are loose fit bearings. They can only take on radial forces. They permit a certain amount of axial displacement in both directions within the bearing between shaft and housing. The design NU has two solid ribs on the outer ring and an inner ring without rib, while two solid ribs on the inner ring and an outer ring without rib identify the bearings of the design N. Bearings of series N have two fixed flanges on the inner ring and a plain outer ring.

desc: SINGLE ROW FULL COMPLEMENT CYLINDRICAL ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: Single row full complement cylindrical roller bearings are manufactured in the designs NJG. The full complement cylindrical roller bearings are neither sealed nor greased. They can be oil lubricated or grease lubricated at the front. Single row full complement cylindrical roller bearings of the design NJG have a self-retaining roller set. Thus the outer ring with two solid ribs and the roller assembly can be dismantled from the inner ring with a solid rib. Bearings of the design NJG are designed for slowly turning applications with especially highly loads and are manufactured in the heavy series 23.

They can only take on radial forces. They permit a certain amount of axial displacement in both directions within the bearing between shaft and housing. The design NU has two solid ribs on the outer ring and an inner ring without rib. Cylindrical roller bearings of series NU have two fixed flanges on the outer ring, with no flange on the inner ring.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: Inner rings for needle roller bearings are available as separate components. They are typically combined with needle roller and cage assemblies or drawn cup needle roller bearings in applications where the shaft cannot be hardened and ground. The inner rings in the IR series are the standard SKF inner rings for needle roller bearings.

desc: DRAWN CUP NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING WITH OPEN ENDS
tech: Drawn cup needle roller bearings are typically used in applications where the housing bore cannot be used as a raceway for a needle roller and cage assembly, but where a very compact and economical bearing arrangement is required. Owing to their large number of rollers, the bearings have a high load carrying capacity and stiffness. It has High radial load carrying capacity, High stiffness & Very low cross-sectional height.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: NF Series has Outer Ring Slides One Way. Cylindrical bearing type NF has single-ribbed outer and double-ribbed inner rings and can support heavy radial loads, as well as light unidirectional thrust loads up to 10 percent of the radial load. The thrust load is transmitted between the diagonally opposed rib faces in a sliding rather than a rolling motion. The design features an outer ring with one integral rib and an inner ring with two ribs.

Cylindrical roller bearings for main spindles are used when the very highest precision is required under very high radial load. Typical areas of application include machine tools and printing machinery. The bearings facilitate bearing arrangements with very high precision, high radial rigidity and very high load carrying capacity. In machine tool building, they provide radial support for the main spindle. Super precision cylindrical roller bearings, Non-locating bearing, with tapered bore, taper 1:12, separable, with cage, with ceramic rollers.

Spiral Roller Bearings are designed to carry only radial loads, without fxing the shaft in the axial direction. They can accommodate impact loads and are not very sensitive to contamination. Their load rating is twice less than that of bearings with cylindrical rollers. They can operate at low rotational speed. spiral roller bearing in order to adapt to the high intensity running speed and pressure, with strong hardness and flexibility of steel at the beginning of the design, the material very carefully, and thus have good performance after production. As we all know, many machinery and equipment are highly accurate equipment, and its accessories have to match it, so the spiral roller bearings is a high precision parts, the size is more standard, higher accuracy. Roller roller bearings used in the material has a high annealing temperature, very suitable for working in a higher temperature environment, it is less sensitive to temperature. spiral roller bearings durable, can effectively block dirt, iron filings and dust into the equipment. At the same time, its operation also provides a relatively large space to keep the rollers running smoothly. Spiral roller bearing impact resistance is strong, not easy to deformation.

desc: Hydraulic Pump Split Needle Roller Bearing
tech: Hydraulic Pump Split Needle Roller Bearing. The crescent swing bearing includes an arc-shaped outer ring with rib, an arc-shaped inner ring, a raceway and a roller. A raceway is formed between the outer ring and the inner ring, or the raceway is directly formed between the outer ring and the swing surface of the swing component. The swing surfaces at both ends of the roller are fixed with baffle plates for limiting the rollers.It can be used in corrosive enviroment to prolong the serivce life of bearings and swing components.

subName: Cylindrical roller bearings Without Outer Ring
desc: Single Row Full Complement Cylindrical Roller Bearings
tech: Type B : 2 Flange Rings & 2 Snap Rings. Roller and needle roller bearings can withstand only radial loads, even very strong ones, with moderate rotational speeds. To make maximum use of the available space, cylindrical roller bearings with one or more full-fill crowns are made. They can have special coatings, e.g., chrome, phosphating, galvanizing, or black oxide. They are made of typical chromium bearing steel, either full hardening or case hardening. Main Applilcations : Planetary gearboxes, textile machines.

desc: Double Row Full Complement Cylindrical Roller Bearings
tech: Type A : Two Flange Rings + One Snap Rings. Double row full complement cylindrical roller bearings feature solid inner and outer rings, as well as rolling elements properly guided between ribs. The double-row cylindrical roller bearings have a high load capacity due to the high number of cylindrical rollers in each row, and the proprietary optimized roller ring profile that results in the best load distribution. Double-row bearings feature a lubrication groove and a lubrication hole in the middle of the outer ring.

These bearing is a high-precision, machined-type radial needle roller bearing designed without an inner ring. Applications : Textile Machinery, Construction & Agricultural Equipment, Printing Presses, Packaging Machinery, Woodworking Machinery, Paper Processing Mills, Conveyor Systems & Material Handling, Machine Tool Spindles & Workholding Systems. Features include optimized load distribution, enhanced operational reliability, improved wear resistance, and potential for sealed or open designs with interchangeability, High load capacity, Durability. Rolling Mill Applications : These bearings are frequently used in the roll necks of steel rolling mills.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: Single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. Easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing.

This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. Easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing.

Double Row full complement cylindrical roller bearings are, because of their second row of rollers, suitable for very heavy radial loads and provide increased radial stiffness. Double row full complement cylindrical roller bearings are non-separable and have an annular groove and lubrication holes in the outer ring to facilitate lubrication NNF design bearings have additional lubrication holes in the inner ring.

The bearing full-complement cylindrical roller bearing. It is a double-row design, meaning it has two rows of cylindrical rollers. The \"PP\" suffix likely indicates a \"full complement\" design, meaning there are no cages to hold the rollers, allowing for a maximum number of rollers.  This is a common bearing designation used for cylindrical roller bearings. PP: This suffix often indicates a \"full complement\" design, where the bearing is designed to hold as many rollers as possible, without a cage.This type of bearing is typically used in applications where there are high radial loads and lower rotational speeds, such as in industrial machinery and other heavy-duty applications

The bearing full complement cylindrical roller bearing with specific features. Specifically, the \"NNF\" indicates a full complement type. PP\" indicates the bearing\'s design features (like internal clearance), and \"C3\" signifies a larger radial clearance than standard. This denotes a type of cylindrical roller bearing where the rollers fill the entire raceway space, maximizing load-carrying capacity. PP : This part indicates the bearing\'s internal clearance. While the exact meaning of \"PP\" can vary depending on the manufacturer, it generally refers to a particular design feature or internal clearance class. C3 : This signifies that the bearing has a larger than standard radial clearance. This means there is more space between the rolling elements and the raceways, allowing for expansion and contraction under load, which can be advantageous in high-speed or high-temperature applications.

The bearing full-complement double-row cylindrical roller bearing. This bearing has a particularly high radial load capacity. The design consists of a solid inner and outer ring with a double row of cylindrical rollers. These rolling elements are guided between flanges. Since there is no cage, a maximum number of rollers can be used. This type of bearing is therefore suitable for very heavy loads where lower rotational speeds are involved.PP : Lip Seals On Both Sides Of The Bearing, 2NR : Two Locking Groove In Outer Ring.

HF-KF bearing allows rotation in one direction while locking the bearing in the opposite direction to transmit torque. Its unique design and functionality make it indispensable in various mechanical systems. Features are : Compact Design: This bearing saves space and reduces the overall weight of the machinery or system. Torque Transmission: Efficiently transmit torque when engaged, providing high load-carrying capacity due to the line contact of needle rollers. High Load Capacity: It can handle high radial loads due to their design, which distributes the load over a larger area. Low free-wheeling frictional torque, High lock accuracy. KF : Plastic Springs.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
desc: TAPER ROLLER BEARINGS WITH CYLINDRICAL BORE
tech: Tapered roller bearings according to (DIN ISO 355 & DIN 720) comprise an outer and inner ring with tapered raceways as well as tapered rollers in a window cage. These are single row individual bearings, usually of open design, which for technical reasons are always adjusted against a second tapered roller bearing in a mirror image arrangement. Open bearings are not self-retaining. As a result, the inner ring with the rollers and the cage can be mounted separately from the outer ring.Tapered roller bearings can support high radial and axial loads in equal measure. Depending on the arrangement, they are suitable when precise axial guidance of the shaft is required (locating bearing function), or when the bearing arrangement must have very high axial rigidity and be operated clearance-free or under preload.Tapered roller bearings are available as: Single row tapered roller bearings of standard design.

Needle roller and cage assemblies are self-contained, ready-to-mount bearings without inner and outer rings. In applications where the shaft and housing bore can serve as raceways, the assemblies can be used to create bearing arrangements that require minimal radial space. As the clearance of the bearing arrangement is only affected by the roller sorting and the finish of shaft and housing, very precise bearing arrangements can be achieved. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, High stiffness, High precision, High performance, Space-saving design, Hardened raceways required, Lowest cross-sectional height among rolling bearings, Accommodate axial displacement in both directions. Applications : Automotive and truck transmissions, Agricultural and construction equipment, Pumps and compressors, High-speed machine tools, Robotics, Conveyor systems, Aerospace components.

Drawn cup needle roller bearings are typically used in applications where the housing bore cannot be used as a raceway for a needle roller and cage assembly, but where a very compact and economical bearing arrangement is required. Owing to the large number of rollers, the bearings have a high load carrying capacity and stiffness. They are an excellent choice for compact bearing arrangements in applications where hardened and ground raceways can be provided on the shaft. The outer ring includes two integral flanges to guide the bearing axially and an annular groove with one or more lubrication holes to facilitate relubrication. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, High stiffness, Low cross-sectional height, Accommodate axial displacement in both directions, Relubrication feature, Compact design, Increased shaft rigidity. Applications : Material handling, Power tools, Aerospace systems, General machinery, Conveyor systems, Construction and mining equipment, Pumps and compressors, Power transmission equipment, Gearboxes and reducers, Engine components, Automotive applications.

Alignment needle roller bearings are self-aligning and offer a compact solution in applications where less space is available. Owing to their large number of rollers, they have a high load carrying capacity. Their internal design, where a convex outer ring meets two concave seating rings encased in a drawn sleeve, enables the bearings to compensate for initial errors of alignment. Bearings with an inner ring are used for applications where the shaft cannot be hardened and ground. Materials : It is made from standard bearing steel and is not coated. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, Accommodate static initial misalignment, Low cross-sectional height, Self-aligning capacity, Compact design. Applications : Lifting equipment, Agricultural machinery, Pumps and compressors, Air conditioning units and fans, General engineering, Gearboxes and transmissions, Conveyor system, Mining and construction machinery, Engine components.

Their low cross-sectional height makes the bearings particularly suitable for applications where other types of locating bearing arrangements occupy too much space. The thrust part has a cover with lubrication holes. Material : The bearing is constructed from durable bearing steel. Features are : Accommodate radial and axial loads in one direction, High load carrying capacity, Low cross section, Non-separable design, Space-saving. Applications : Industrial gearboxes, Machine tools, Textile machinery, Agricultural machinery, Pumps and compressors, Printing machinery, Conveyor belts, Power tools, Mining equipment, Earth-moving machinery, Electric motors and fans.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: These single row tapered roller bearings offer cost-effective solutions for applications operating at moderate loads, such as many agricultural applications. They can accommodate combined radial and axial loads and provide low friction during operation. The inner ring, with rollers and cage, can be mounted separately from the outer ring. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are : Designed for moderate loads, like in many agricultural applications, Moderate radial and axial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads in one direction, Low friction and long service life, Separable and interchangeable components. Applications : Tillage equipment, Tractors, Gearboxes, Conveyor systems, Construction and mining, Rolling mills, Wind turbines, Machine tools.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: Tapered roller bearing cones (inner ring with rollers and cage) are intended to be combined with cups (outer ring) from the same series. Together they create a complete bearing that accommodates combined radial and axial loads and provides low friction during operation. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are : Can be combined with cups from the same series, High radial and axial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads in one direction, Low friction and long service life. Applications : Automotive wheel bearings, Gearboxes, Construction equipment, Mining conveyors and bulk handling, Industrial transmissions.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: Tapered roller bearing cups (outer ring) are intended to be combined with cones (inner ring with rollers and cage) from the same series. Together they create a complete bearing that accommodates combined radial and axial loads and provides low friction during operation. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are : High radial and axial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads in one direction, Low friction and long service life, Separable design, Various series available to accommodate prevailing loads in application. Applications : Automotive wheel hubs, Transmissions, Gearboxes, Conveyor systems.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a cone for a single-row tapered roller bearing. This removable cone consists of the inner ring and rollers of the bearing. Together with a separately available cup (or outer ring), these parts make up a complete tapered roller bearing. The inner and outer rings have conical raceways and the rollers are tapered. This design enables tapered roller bearings to absorb radial and axial forces (in one direction). The geometrical qualities of tapered roller bearings prevent sliding movements between the raceways and rollers. This will keep component wear down to a minimum. However, a minimum load is required for proper bearing operation. Because cone and cup are separable, they can easily be mounted. In addition, end play (axial clearance) or preload can be adjusted by moving the components axially during assembly. Q : TQ-Line Execution.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone

This cup is an outer ring that can be combined with a separately available cone (the cage with rolling elements), to form a complete tapered roller bearing. The outer and inner rings have conical raceways and the roller elements are conical as well. This design enables tapered roller bearings to absorb radial and axial forces (in one direction). The greater the angle between the outer ring and the centre line of the bearing, the greater the axial load capacity. The geometrical qualities of tapered roller bearings prevent sliding movements between the raceways and rollers. This will keep component wear down to a minimum. However, a minimum load is required for proper bearing operation. Because cone and cup are separable, they can easily be mounted. In addition, end play (axial clearance) or preload can be adjusted by moving the components axially during assembly. Q : TQ-Line Execution, CL7C : High-Performance Design For Pinion Bearing Arrangements.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing. Q : TQ-Line Execution, CL7C : High-Performance Design For Pinion Bearing Arrangements.

This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing. X : External Dimensions Matched To International Standards, P5 : Dimensional And Running Accuracy To ISO Tolerance Class 5.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: Single row tapered roller bearings are designed to accommodate combined radial and axial loads and provide low friction during operation. The inner ring, with rollers and cage, can be mounted separately from the outer ring. These separable and interchangeable components facilitate mounting, dismounting and maintenance. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are : High radial and axial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads in one direction, Low friction and long service life, Separable and interchangeable components. Applications : Automotive wheel hubs, Heavy machinery, Rolling mills, Hoisting equipment, Wind turbines, Pumps and compressors. X : Boundary Dimensions Changed To Conform To ISO Standards, VB129 : Corner Radii On The Inner Ring.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a cone for a single-row tapered roller bearing. This removable cone consists of the inner ring and rollers of the bearing. Together with a separately available cup (or outer ring), these parts make up a complete tapered roller bearing. The inner and outer rings have conical raceways and the rollers are tapered. This design enables tapered roller bearings to absorb radial and axial forces (in one direction). The geometrical qualities of tapered roller bearings prevent sliding movements between the raceways and rollers. This will keep component wear down to a minimum. However, a minimum load is required for proper bearing operation. Because cone and cup are separable, they can easily be mounted. In addition, end play (axial clearance) or preload can be adjusted by moving the components axially during assembly. Q : TQ-Line Execution.

This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing. subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: Single row tapered roller bearings are designed to accommodate combined radial and axial loads and provide low friction during operation. The inner ring, with rollers and cage, can be mounted separately from the outer ring. These separable and interchangeable components facilitate mounting, dismounting and maintenance. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are : High radial and axial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads in one direction, Low friction and long service life, Separable and interchangeable components. Applications : Industrial automation, Automotive transmissions, Heavy machinery, Gearboxes , Pumps and compressors, Electric motors, Construction equipment, Mining equipment. X : Boundary Dimensions Changed To Conform To ISO Standards, P5 : Dimensional And Running Accuracy To ISO Tolerance Class 5.

tech: SKF is a cone for a single-row tapered roller bearing. This removable cone consists of the inner ring and rollers of the bearing. Together with a separately available cup (or outer ring), these parts make up a complete tapered roller bearing. The inner and outer rings have conical raceways and the rollers are tapered. This design enables tapered roller bearings to absorb radial and axial forces (in one direction). The geometrical qualities of tapered roller bearings prevent sliding movements between the raceways and rollers. This will keep component wear down to a minimum. However, a minimum load is required for proper bearing operation. Because cone and cup are separable, they can easily be mounted. In addition, end play (axial clearance) or preload can be adjusted by moving the components axially during assembly. Q : TQ-Line Execution.

This cup is an outer ring that can be combined with a separately available cone (the cage with rolling elements), to form a complete tapered roller bearing. The outer and inner rings have conical raceways and the roller elements are conical as well. This design enables tapered roller bearings to absorb radial and axial forces (in one direction). The greater the angle between the outer ring and the centre line of the bearing, the greater the axial load capacity. The geometrical qualities of tapered roller bearings prevent sliding movements between the raceways and rollers. This will keep component wear down to a minimum. However, a minimum load is required for proper bearing operation. Because cone and cup are separable, they can easily be mounted. In addition, end play (axial clearance) or preload can be adjusted by moving the components axially during assembly. Q : TQ-Line Execution.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: These tapered roller bearing cones (inner ring with rollers and cage) offer cost-effective solutions for applications operating at moderate loads, such as many agricultural applications. Combined with corresponding cups (outer ring), they create a complete bearing that accommodates combined loads and provides low friction. By mounting one single row tapered roller bearing against another and applying a preload, a rigid bearing application can be achieved. Features are : Designed for moderate loads, like in many agricultural applications, Can be combined with corresponding cups, Moderate radial and axial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads in one direction, Low friction and long service life. VA : Application Oriented Variants.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing. Q : TQ-Line Execution.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a cup for a single-row tapered roller bearing. This cup is an outer ring that can be combined with a separately available cone (the cage with rolling elements), to form a complete tapered roller bearing. The outer and inner rings have conical raceways and the roller elements are conical as well. This design enables tapered roller bearings to absorb radial and axial forces (in one direction). The greater the angle between the outer ring and the centre line of the bearing, the greater the axial load capacity. The geometrical qualities of tapered roller bearings prevent sliding movements between the raceways and rollers. This will keep component wear down to a minimum. However, a minimum load is required for proper bearing operation. Because cone and cup are separable, they can easily be mounted. In addition, end play (axial clearance) or preload can be adjusted by moving the components axially during assembly. 2 : Standard Tolerance For Inch Cone And Cup +0,050mm, Q : Optimized Internal Geometry And Surface Finish, CL7C : High-Performance Design For Pinion Bearing Arrangements.

subName: Taper Roller Bearings Cup and Cone
tech: SKF is a single-row tapered roller bearing. This bearing type gets its name from the tapered rollers between the inner and outer rings. The raceways are conical. This design allows these versatile bearings to accommodate combined loads. They support high radial and axial loads (in one direction). The greater the contact angle, the greater the axial load capacity. SKF is easy to (dis)assemble as it is a combination of a cup and a cone. The cone unit consists of an inner ring with cage and roller set. The cup is the outer ring. Single-row tapered roller bearings have an open design. Because of the internal construction, they must be mounted in mirror-image arrangement together with a second tapered roller bearing. Q : TQ-Line Execution.

The incorporation of seals into the bearing offers an additional barrier to contaminant ingress, providing exceptional sealing capability in combination with the housing seals. Features are : Split-to-shaft for easy maintenance, Replace non-split bearings mounted on adapter sleeves, Mount in standard housings with minimum disturbance of machine alignment, Provide exceptional sealing capability in conjunction with housing seals. Applications : Conveyor systems, Marine propulsion systems, Fans and blowers, Mining and cement production equipment. 2SRS : Synthetic rubber seals on both sides.

MR series CAGEROL bearings are interchangeable dimensionally with all heavy-duty needle bearings. They are available with or without separable inner races. Cage type CAGEROL bearings from McGill are designed especially to meet the performance requirements of applications where greater shaft misalignment and higher speeds exceed the capabilities of ordinary full complement needle roller bearings. Features Are : Radial space is limited. Maximum radial load rating within space limitation is required. Higher speeds are present. Greater misalignment is present, Lower internal friction is required. Greater lubrication reservoir is required. The suffix \"SS\" indicates double seals with lips turned in. This construction is most common and is intended primarily for lubrication retention.

Materials : The bearing rings and rolling elements are made from 52100 bearing steel, and it features a steel cage. K=Tapered Bore, Taper 1:12, W33=Lubrication Groove And Three Holes In Bearing Outer Ring, TSS : Twin (double) Standard Seals. These are high-temperature seals that prevent contamination and retain lubricant, VA : High-Temperature Grease & Seals.

Combined bearings like the RAXF Series are designed to simultaneously support both radial and axial loads on a shaft. They comprise a needle thrust bearing and needle cage retained in a common outer ring. The technical characteristics of the thrust bearing and the needle cage are set out in the appropriate sections. These bearings form one integral unit permitting easy storage, handling and fitting. Their high radial and axial load capacities and small space requirement enable cost effective solutions to be achieved. The bearings can be used without inner rings or thrust plates, if the shaft journals serving as raceways are of sufficient hardness and possess a suitable surface finish.

These bearing is a spherical roller bearing with an open design. This bearing type has a solid inner ring, which runs on two rows of symmetrical rollers in a solid outer ring. The outer ring has a concave, spherical raceway. This design compensates for any alignment errors and shaft deflections. Spherical roller bearings can withstand particularly high radial loads. Additionally, they can accommodate axial forces in both directions. These bearings are used in elevators, textile machines, food processing machines, cranes etc. CC : Two Window-Type Steel Cages, Flangeless Inner Ring And Guide Ring Centered On The Inner Ring, C3 : Internal Clearance Larger Than Normal.

Spherical roller bearings with designation suffix VA9A1 are specifically designed for demanding low-speed applications. Features are : Designed for low-speed applications and horizontal shaft position, Accommodate misalignment, Optimized design with improved lubrication and low friction, long service life​, Increased wear resistance, reduced maintenance, Fully interchangeable with standard spherical roller bearings. The Nadella RAXN series is a combined needle roller bearing designed to simultaneously support both radial and axial loads. It is a heavy-duty, integral unit suitable for applications that require high precision and robustness. The RAXN series combines a needle thrust bearing (or roller thrust bearing) and a needle cage in a single outer ring. This integrated design simplifies storage, handling, and fitting. The thrust bearing and needle cage operate independently, which prevents any interaction that could harm precise axial and radial rotation. The bearing can be used without inner rings or thrust plates, provided the shaft journals that serve as raceways are sufficiently hard and smooth. Features are : High Precision (Machine-Tool Quality), High Load Capacity, Robust Construction, Cost-Effective Solution, Open Design for Lubrication. Applications : Machine tool spindles and gearboxes, Printing machinery, Industrial automation and robotic systems.

This bearing features are unique, compact design that integrates two types of bearing elements within a single, high-quality steel outer ring. This design simplifies mounting and saves space, making it an efficient solution for installations where radial space is limited. Material : Constructed from high-quality chrome steel, the bearing is designed for longevity and strong performance under heavy loads. Features are : Simultaneous Load Support, High Running Accuracy, Tight Tolerances, Cost-Effective Solution, High Axial Loads, Operational Flexibility and Maintenance, Space-Saving. Applications : Machine Tools, Printing Presses, Industrial Gearboxes, Textile Machinery, Pumps, Compressors, and Turbines, Material Handling Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, Automation Systems and Robotics, General Industrial Machinery.

desc: DRAWN CUP ROLLER BEARING WITH CLOSED END
tech: The Nadella DLF series is a full complement drawn cup needle roller bearing with a closed end. It is known for its high load capacity, low profile, and ability to protect internal components from debris. The bearing\'s thin-walled outer ring is formed from a deep drawing process, allowing it to have a very small cross-section. This is ideal for applications with limited radial space. Materials : The bearing is constructed from durable steel. Features are : High load capacity, Compact size, Easy to mount, High stiffness, Resistance to external damage, Reliability in harsh environments, Low friction design, Maintenance considerations, Ease of installation. Applications : Pumps and compressors, Machine Tools, Printing Presses, Textile Machinery, Wood Working Machines, Electro-medical Machines, Medical Equipment, Mining Equipment, Automated systems and robotics, Agricultural machinery.

These bearing is a high-capacity spherical roller bearing designed for heavy industrial applications, featuring self-aligning properties and lubrication grooves in the outer ring. The bearing has barrel-shaped rollers and a spherical outer ring raceway, allowing it to automatically correct for shaft deflection or housing misalignment. This prevents excessive force on the bearing in misaligned conditions. It is designed to handle heavy radial loads and moderate axial loads in both directions, making it suitable for applications with heavy or impact loads. Material : Chrome Steel (Normal bearing steel). Features are : Impact and Shock Loads, Harsh Environments, Maintenance Efficiency, Integrated Lubrication System, Low Starting Torque. Applications: Mining and Quarrying, Material Handling, Wind Energy, Industrial Gearboxes, Power Generation, Paper and Pulp Mills. CD= Spherical Roller Bearing, Two-Piece Pressed Steel Cage With Guide Ring, E4=Lubrication Groove And Holes In Bearing Outer Ring.

These bearing is a high-capacity, self-aligning spherical roller bearing with a tapered bore and lubrication features, designed for applications involving heavy radial and some axial loads. These bearing is a double-row spherical roller bearing featuring barrel-shaped rollers operating between two inner ring raceways and a common spherical outer ring raceway. The bearing\'s design ensures that the center of curvature of the outer ring raceway coincides with the bearing axis, which enables it to be self-aligning and automatically correct for shaft deflection or misalignment of the housing without applying excessive force to the bearing. It can sustain heavy radial loads as well as some axial loads in both directions, making it suitable for use in demanding applications where heavy or impact loads are present, such as industrial machinery, construction works, and mining equipment. CD=Spherical Roller Bearing, Two-Piece Pressed Steel Cage With Guide Ring, E4=Lubrication Groove And Holes In Bearing Outer Ring, K=Tapered Bore, Taper 1:12.

These bearing is a double-row spherical roller bearing known for its high load capacity and ability to accommodate misalignment. The design also allows the bearing to be self-aligning, meaning it can tolerate angular misalignment of the shaft relative to the housing without generating excessive friction or heat. Material : The main bearing is made of high-grade steel, while the cage is constructed from stamped steel. Features are : Self-Alignment, Extended Service Life, Reduced Maintenance, Speed Capability. Applications : Material Handling, Mining and Construction, Industrial Transmissions, Vibratory Equipment, Power Generation, Marine & Offshore, Metal & Steel Processing. C=Two-Piece Pressed Steel Cage With Guide Ring, E4 =Lubrication Groove And Holes In Bearing Outer Ring.

The NSK bearing is a high-performance spherical roller bearing known for its self-aligning capability, suitability for heavy loads, and features that facilitate relubrication. Its designation indicates a tapered bore, steel cage, and lubrication groove and holes in the outer ring. The design with a common sphered outer ring raceway allows the bearing to accommodate significant angular misalignment of the shaft relative to the housing without generating excessive stress or heat. The double row of symmetrical rollers is designed to sustain heavy radial loads and moderate axial loads in both directions. Features are : Self-Alignment, High-Temperature Stability, Extended Lifespan, Reduced Maintenance Costs. Applications : Material Handling Systems, Crushing and Mining Equipment, Power Transmission, General Engineering, Pulp and Paper Processing, Agriculture and Construction, Renewable Energy, Railway and Marine. C=Two-Piece Pressed Steel Cage With Guide Ring, K=Tapered Bore, Taper 1:12, E4=Lubrication Groove And Holes In Bearing Outer Ring.

It is capable of sustaining high radial loads, axial loads in both directions, and combined loads simultaneously. Features are : Self-Alignment Capabilities, High Load Capacity, Longer Service Life, Reduced Maintenance Costs, Energy Efficiency. Applications : Mining and Construction, Pulp and Paper Industry, Industrial Gearboxes and Drives, Material Handling, Steel and Metal Production, Power Generation, Pumps and Compressors, Marine Engineering. It\'s designed for heavy radial and axial loads under conditions of potential shaft misalignment. Material : Standard bearing steel. Features are : High Load Capacity, Temperature Stability, Optimized Internal Design, Accommodation of Misalignment. Applications : Quarrying, Mining, & Construction Equipment, Industrial Gearboxes and Transmissions, Pulp and Paper Making Machines, Pumps and Compressors, Steel and Metals Industry. E=Increased Load Capacity CAM,One Piece Brass Cage, Guide Ring, K=Tapered Bore, Taper 1:12, E4=Lubrication Groove And Holes In Bearing Outer Ring.

It is capable of handling very heavy radial and substantial axial loads in both directions, making it suitable for applications with heavy or impact loads. Material : The bearing is made of high-quality bearing steel. Features are  : Enhanced Lubrication System, High Performance Standards, Super-Finish Raceways, Optimized Internal Geometry, High-Temperature Capability. Applications : Mining and Quarrying, Pulp and Paper, Construction Machinery, Industrial Gearboxes, Fans and Blowers, Pumps and Compressors, Power Generation, Agricultural Equipment. CAM=One Piece Brass Cage, Guide Ring, E4=Lubrication Groove And Holes In Bearing Outer Ring.

These bearing is a high-performance spherical roller bearing with a tapered bore and a durable machined brass cage, designed to accommodate heavy loads and significant misalignment in demanding industrial environments.  The bearing is designed with a common sphered outer ring raceway that allows it to automatically correct for misalignment or shaft deflection without increasing friction or temperature.Capable of handling extremely high radial loads and moderate axial loads in both directions. Material : Standard bearing steel, manufactured with high purity steel for superior fatigue strength. Applications : Mining and Quarrying, Crushers and Powdering Machines, Conveyor Systems, Steel and Metal Manufacturing, Pulp and Paper Industry, Industrial Gearboxes, Energy & Power Generation, Marine & Offshore Engineering. It\'s designed for heavy radial and axial loads under conditions of potential shaft misalignment. Material : Standard bearing steel. Features are : High Load Capacity, Temperature Stability, Optimized Internal Design, Accommodation of Misalignment. Applications : Quarrying, Mining, & Construction Equipment, Industrial Gearboxes and Transmissions, Pulp and Paper Making Machines, Pumps and Compressors, Steel and Metals Industry. E=Increased Load Capacity CAM,One Piece Brass Cage, Guide Ring, K=Tapered Bore, Taper 1:12, E4=Lubrication Groove And Holes In Bearing Outer Ring.

The bearing has a common sphered outer ring raceway, allowing it to automatically correct for shaft deflection, housing misalignment, or installation errors, which prevents excessive force from being applied to the bearing.  It is capable of handling very heavy radial and substantial axial loads in both directions, making it suitable for applications with heavy or impact loads. The FC-K bearing is a needle roller clutch bearing (also known as a one-way lock bearing) designed to provide high load capacity within a compact radial space. Its primary function is to permit free rotation in one direction and to lock (transmit torque) in the opposite direction. The \"K\" suffix indicates it typically utilizes a plastic/nylon cage assembly for the needle rollers. The FC-K acts as a freewheel mechanism or backstop clutch. It allows relative motion between the shaft and housing in one direction (overrunning) and prevents it in the other (locking), enabling functions like indexing or preventing reverse rotation in machinery. The bearing features a drawn outer cup (outer ring) and a full complement of needle rollers guided by a cage assembly. This design ensures a low radial section height, contributing to the miniaturization and weight reduction of machinery. Applications : Automatic Transmissions, Conveyor Systems, Packaging and Printing Machinery, Machine Tools and Electric Machines, Pumps and Compressors, Office Equipment, Power Tools, Aerospace Equipment, Fitness Equipment,Construction Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, Mining and Petroleum.

The FCS Nadella bearing is a specialized drawn cup roller clutch designed to transmit torque in one direction while allowing free overrunning in the opposite direction. It features a compact, low-profile design ideal for high-load applications with limited radial space. The bearing\'s full complement of needle rollers and stainless steel springs contribute to its ability to handle high engagement rates and support significant loads. It functions as a roller clutch, capable of rotational torque only, making it suitable for indexing, backstopping, and overrunning applications. Material : Alloy Steel (Cup and Rollers). Features are : Low Radial Profile, Compact & Lightweight Design,  High Performance, Press Fit Mounting, Open End Type. Applications : Office Equipment, Automotive Systems, Conveyor Systems, Pumps and Compressors, Textile Machinery, Robotics & Automation, Medical Equipment, Seeding and Planting Equipment, Steering Systems.

The FC bearing is a full complement drawn cup roller clutch (a type of one-way needle roller bearing) designed to transmit torque in one direction and allow free rotation in the opposite direction. It features a thin-walled, drawn outer ring with ramps on the inside diameter, along with plastic cages, pressure springs, and needle rollers. The full complement of rollers provides a high load capacity for its compact size. The primary function is as a one-way clutch for applications requiring indexing, backstopping, or overrunning. Materials: The inner and outer races and the rolling elements are made of steel. It is designed for simple press-fit installation into a housing hole and does not require fixing the direction of the shaft. Applications : Automotive Systems, Conveyor systems, Printing presses, Textile and packaging equipment, Feed mechanisms and rack indexing drives, Pumps and compressors, Agricultural and Gardening Machinery, General Power Transmission, Fitness Equipment.

The FCL-K bearing is designed to transmit torque in one direction of rotation while allowing free-wheeling in the opposite direction. It is a compact, full-complement needle roller bearing which requires a hardened and machined shaft for optimal performance, as it does not come with an inner ring. A key feature of the Nadella FCL-K series is the use of a stainless steel spring for the roller clutch, which contributes to higher operating temperatures and durability compared to standard polymer springs. It features a thin-walled, drawn outer cup that is press-fit into the housing. This design provides high load capacity within minimal radial space. The bearing does not include an inner ring, requiring the user\'s shaft to be hardened and precisely machined to serve as the inner raceway for optimal performance and extended bearing life. Applications : Industrial gearboxes, Conveyor Systems, Automatic Machinery, Washing Machines and Dryers, Office Equipment, Office Equipment, Agricultural Equipment, Textile and Printing Machinery, Packaging Machinery.

The Nadella FCBN-K is a lightweight, drawn cup roller clutch (one-way bearing) from Nadella\'s light series, designed to transmit torque in a single direction in compact industrial applications. It has a thin-walled, deep-drawn steel outer ring with a series of ramps on its inner diameter. This design allows for a very compact, space-saving arrangement. It uses a full complement of needle rollers as clamping elements, held in place by a plastic cage and individual stainless steel springs. It locks when rotated in one direction (transmitting torque) and allows free movement (overrunning) in the opposite direction. This makes it suitable for indexing, backstopping, and overrunning applications. The outer ring is designed for a secure press-fit into a housing bore, which helps prevent axial and radial displacement. Proper installation requires specialized tools to avoid damage to the thin cup. Applications : Textile & Industrial Machinery, Medical & Laboratory Equipment, Fitness & Athletic Equipment, Material Handling.

desc: GUIDE NEEDLES ROLLER WITH INNER RING
tech: The Nadella NKJS series  is a precision needle roller bearing with an inner ring, part of the \"heavy series\" designed for high-performance industrial motion. It is characterized by its ability to carry substantial radial loads in a compact design, particularly where the shaft itself cannot be used as a raceway. The NKJS series (equivalent to the NKIS series) features a larger outside diameter and heavier load capacity compared to the standard NKI light series. The bearing consists of an outer ring with a cage-guided needle roller assembly and a separate inner ring. This allows for independent mounting of the rings, simplifying assembly in complex machinery. Material : Manufactured from high-grade hardened bearing steel (typically GCr15) to ensure high fatigue resistance and durability. Features are : Lubrication Efficiency, High-Speed Performance, Wide Temperature Range, Open Design. Applications : Machine Tool Spindles, Textile Machinery, Robotics and Automation, Printing Presses, Pumps and Compressors, Agricultural Machinery, Power Tools, Material Handling, Renewable Energy, HVAC Systems.

It is characterized by its ability to carry substantial radial loads in a compact design, particularly where the shaft itself cannot be used as a raceway. The NKJS series (equivalent to the NKIS series) features a larger outside diameter and heavier load capacity compared to the standard NKI light series. The bearing consists of an outer ring with a cage-guided needle roller assembly and a separate inner ring. This allows for independent mounting of the rings, simplifying assembly in complex machinery. Material : Manufactured from high-grade hardened bearing steel (typically GCr15) to ensure high fatigue resistance and durability. Features are : Lubrication Efficiency, High-Speed Performance, Wide Temperature Range, Open Design. Applications : Machine Tool Spindles, Textile Machinery, Robotics and Automation, Printing Presses, Pumps and Compressors, Agricultural Machinery, Power Tools, Material Handling, Renewable Energy, HVAC Systems.

desc: GUIDE NEEDLES ROLLER WITH INNER RING
tech: The NKJ Nadella bearing is a specific, machined-type single-row needle roller bearing that includes a separable inner ring, designed for high radial load capacity and high stiffness in compact applications. The NKJ5/12 bearing is a complete bearing unit that consists of a machined outer ring with two non-separable flanges, a needle roller and cage assembly, and a matching inner ring. This design means the components form a self-retaining unit but can be separated during mounting. Material : Bearing steel rings and rollers, often with a reinforced nylon (polyamide 66) cage in modern designs. Features are : High-Speed Capability, Open Design, Accommodates Axial Displacement, Separable Design, Enhanced Lubrication System, High-Precision Tolerances, Friction Efficiency. Applications : Transmissions and Gearboxes, Machine Tools, Pumps and Compressors, Textile and Printing Machinery, Packaging and Food Industry, Robotics and Automation, Power Tools, Office and Commercial Equipment, Agricultural Equipment.

They are an excellent choice for compact bearing arrangements in applications where hardened and ground raceways can be provided on the shaft. The outer ring includes two integral flanges to guide the bearing axially and an annular groove with one or more lubrication holes to facilitate relubrication. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, High stiffness, Low cross-sectional height, Accommodate axial displacement in both directions.

desc: GUIDE NEEDLES ROLLER WITH INNER RING
tech: The NKS Nadella bearing is a single-row, machined-ring needle roller bearing designed for applications with high radial loads and limited space, which requires the shaft to be a hardened raceway. The NKS series is an open-type bearing (without seals) that features a high load-carrying capacity relative to its compact cross-section. The outer ring has integral flanges to provide axial guidance for the needle roller and cage assembly.  Single row needle roller bearing with machined outer ring, without an inner ring. Material : Typically made from high-quality bearing or chrome steel for durability and performance. Features are : High-Speed Capability, Wide Temperature Range, Low Friction Operation, Corrosion Resistance. Applications : Automotive engines and transmission systems, Machine tools, Agricultural machinery, Conveyor systems, Robotics and packaging machinery, Construction Equipment, Mining Equipment.

tech: These bearing is a high-precision drawn cup needle roller bearing manufactured by INA. It features a compact radial design engineered to support heavy radial loads in spaces with limited installation volume. The bearing features a closed cup on one side, which seals the end of a shaft, retains lubricant, and protects the internal components from external contaminants. The outer housing is made of cold-formed, thin-walled sheet steel, providing maximum radial performance with minimal outer diameter clearance. Material : Made of high-purity, through-hardened carbon-chromium steel with a cold-formed sheet steel outer cup. Features are : Built-in Lubrication Groove, Extremely Low Cross-Section, Low Mass Moment of Inertia, Oscillating Motion Accommodation, Low Operating Torque, Shell Wall Profile, High-Speed Operating Limits. Applications : Automotive Transmissions & Gearboxes, Industrial Automation & Robotics, Power Tools & Outdoor Equipment, Textile & Printing Machinery, Medical Equipment & Lab Devices, Agricultural Feed & Seed Metering, Offshore & Marine Control Linkages. BK =Drawn Cup Needle Roller Bearing With a Closed End .

desc: DRAWN CUP NEEDLE ROLLER BEARINGS F-2216  =HK 2216 V
tech: Drawn cup needle roller bearings are typically used in applications where the housing bore cannot be used as a raceway for a needle roller and cage assembly, but where a very compact and economical bearing arrangement is required. Owing to their large number of rollers, the bearings have a high load carrying capacity and stiffness. The integral sealing can significantly prolong bearing service life because it keeps lubricant in the bearings and contaminants out. Sealed bearings are delivered with an initial grease fill. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, High stiffness, Very low cross-sectional height, Sealed for increased reliability, Space-efficient. Applications : Automotive systems, Agricultural machinery, Pumps and fans, Lifting equipment, General engineering and mechanical systems. 2RS : Contact Seal Of Acrylonitrile-Butadiene Rubber (NRB) With Or Without Sheet Steel Reinforcement On Both Sides Of The Bearing.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING WITH CAGE GUIDED NEEDLES WITHOUT INNER RING
tech: The Nadella NB series is a needle roller bearing without an inner ring. This specific design is intended for applications where the shaft can be hardened and ground to serve as the inner raceway. Utilizes needle rollers to provide a large contact surface area, which enables it to handle high radial loads. The bearing is designed to run directly on a hardened and precision-ground shaft, which allows for a smaller radial cross-section compared to bearings with an inner ring. Material : The outer ring and needle rollers are crafted from high-quality, through-hardening chrome steel (similar to AISI 52100 or GCr15 standard), known for its exceptional fatigue resistance, high hardness, and durability. Features are : High Load Capacity, High Stiffness and Precision, Space Efficiency, Open Design, Lightweight. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Automotive Systems, Machine Tools, Automated Machinery and Robotics, Pumps and Compressors, Printing and Textile Machinery, Agricultural Equipment.

Utilizes needle rollers to provide a large contact surface area, which enables it to handle high radial loads. The bearing is designed to run directly on a hardened and precision-ground shaft, which allows for a smaller radial cross-section compared to bearings with an inner ring. Material : The outer ring and needle rollers are crafted from high-quality, through-hardening chrome steel (similar to AISI 52100 or GCr15 standard), known for its exceptional fatigue resistance, high hardness, and durability. Features are : High Load Capacity, High Stiffness and Precision, Space Efficiency, Open Design, Lightweight. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Automotive Systems, Machine Tools, Automated Machinery and Robotics, Pumps and Compressors, Printing and Textile Machinery, Agricultural Equipment.

tech: The Nadella NB series is a needle roller bearing without an inner ring. This specific design is intended for applications where the shaft can be hardened and ground to serve as the inner raceway. Utilizes needle rollers to provide a large contact surface area, which enables it to handle high radial loads. The bearing is designed to run directly on a hardened and precision-ground shaft, which allows for a smaller radial cross-section compared to bearings with an inner ring. Material : The outer ring and needle rollers are crafted from high-quality, through-hardening chrome steel (similar to AISI 52100 or GCr15 standard), known for its exceptional fatigue resistance, high hardness, and durability. Features are : High Load Capacity, High Stiffness and Precision, Space Efficiency, Open Design, Lightweight. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Automotive Systems, Machine Tools, Automated Machinery and Robotics, Pumps and Compressors, Printing and Textile Machinery, Agricultural Equipment.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING WITH CAGE GUIDED NEEDLES INNER RING

Caged needle roller bearing with an inner ring (indicated by the \"NBI\" designation). The cage guides the needles, allowing for higher operating speeds than full-complement designs. The inclusion of a separate, precision-machined inner ring is a key feature. This means the bearing can be used on shafts that are not sufficiently hardened or precision-ground to serve as the inner raceway directly. Material: Typically crafted from durable chrome steel, ensuring a long service life and resistance to wear. Features are : High Radial Load Capacity, Integrated Inner Ring, Compact, Space-Saving Design, High Stiffness and Precision, Reliable Performance, Ease of Assembly. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Machine Tools, Automated Machinery and Robotics, Pumps and Compressors, Printing Machinery, Industrial Automation Systems.

Applications : Automotive Transmissions, Industrial Gearboxes, Power Tools, Agricultural & Construction Machinery, Fluid Power Systems, Textile & Printing Machinery, Office Equipment.

desc: DRAWN CUP NEEDLE ROLLER BEARINGS (CLOSED END)
tech: Drawn cup needle roller bearings are typically used in applications where the housing bore cannot be used as a raceway for a needle roller and cage assembly, but where a very compact and economical bearing arrangement is required. Owing to the large number of rollers, the bearings have a high load carrying capacity and stiffness. The closed end makes them suitable for bearing arrangements where they are situated at the end of a shaft. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, Accommodate small axial guidance forces, High stiffness, Very low cross-sectional height. The HMK....LL bearing is a high-precision drawn cup needle roller bearing. While the \"HMK\" prefix is standard for heavy-duty drawn cup bearings, this specific part number is widely used in systems originally designed for high-load needle bearing. Features a thin-walled, cup-shaped outer ring made of precision-drawn steel, offering a high load-carrying capacity relative to its very small cross-section. Material :Manufactured from high-carbon chromium bearing steel to provide long-lasting resistance to wear and fatigue in demanding industrial environments. Features are : High Load-to-Size Ratio, Operational Reliability, Temperature Resilience, Maintenance Efficiency, Shaft Integration, Easy Press-Fit Assembly. Applications : Transmissions and Gearboxes, Engine Components, Steering Systems, Conveyor Systems, Assembly Lines, Pumping Equipment, Construction & Mining, Textile & Paper Production, Food & Packaging Automation. LL=Double-Sided Contact Seals.

The Nadella NA series is a single-row, full-complement needle roller bearing with machined rings, designed to offer high load-carrying capacity in a compact radial space. It is a complete bearing assembly, including both the outer ring and a separable inner ring. The absence of a cage allows for the maximum number of needle rollers to be incorporated, which significantly increases both the static and dynamic load capacities. Materials : Made from high-quality bearing steel. Features are : High load capacity, Compact size, High stiffness, Accommodates axial displacement, Tolerance and Precision Ratings, Effective Lubrication Management, Robustness in Extreme Conditions. Applications : Agricultural and construction equipment, Pumps and compressors, Conveyor systems, Textile and printing machinery, Machine tools, Mining equipment, Medical equipment.

Single row needle roller bearings incorporate cylindrical rollers that are small in diameter relative to their length. Owing to their large number of rollers, the bearings have a high load carrying capacity. Bearings without flanges on the outer ring are separable, i.e. the outer ring and the needle roller and cage assembly can be mounted separately. Material : Typically manufactured from high-quality carbon chromium bearing steel with a sheet steel cage. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, High stiffness, Low cross-sectional height, Accommodate axial displacement in both directions, Separable design. Applications : Machine Tools, Printing Equipment, Textile Machinery, Lifting & Agricultural Equipment, Pumps & Compressors, Construction & Mining.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARINGS WITH INNER RING
tech: Support rollers (yoke-type track rollers) are designed to run on all types of tracks and to be used in cam drives, conveyor systems, etc. They are based on a needle roller bearing with an inner ring. They have a thick-walled outer ring with a crowned running surface and are supplied ready-to-mount. A narrow gap between the outer ring and the pressed-on flange rings forms a gap-type seal. The inner ring contains a lubrication hole to facilitate relubrication. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, Accommodate axial loads due to skew or tilting, Long service life, Ready to mount, Sealed for increased reliability, with relubrication feature. Applications : Material Handling & Logistics, Packaging & Printing, Machine Tools, Construction Machinery, Agriculture Machinery, Power & Energy. LL= Double-Sealed.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARINGS WITH INNER RING
tech: The Nadella NAW....R6 bearing is a high-capacity, full complement needle roller bearing (radial cylindrical roller type) with an integrated inner ring. It is specifically designed to handle extreme radial loads, shocks, and vibrations in compact industrial setups. This series consists of machined-ring needle roller bearings that are typically \"full complement,\" meaning they lack a cage. This allows for the maximum number of rollers to be packed into the space, providing the highest possible radial load capacity. Material : Manufactured from high-quality chrome steel (typically through-hardened). Features are : Space Efficiency, Oscillating Motion Suitability, Axial Displacement Capability, High Rigidity & Load Capacity, Self-Correction for Misalignment, Temperature Stability, Easy Installation, Precision Manufacturing. Applications : Industrial Machinery & Automation, Automotive Systems, Heavy Construction & Mining, Material Handling, Power Generation, Textile & Printing Machinery, Renewable Energy, Medical Equipment, Off-Highway & Agriculture, Aerospace Systems. R6=Convex (Crowned) Raceway Profile.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARINGS WITH INNER RING

Material : Constructed from high-carbon chromium bearing steel that is through-hardened for high strength, wear resistance, and heat tolerance. Features are : Accommodate radial loads and axial loads in one direction, High load carrying capacity, High-speed capability, Low cross section, Separable design, Temperature Limits, Recommended Shaft Fits. Applications : Automation & Robotics, Automotive Systems, Construction Equipment, Textile Machinery, Precision CNC Machine Tools, Pumps & Compressors, Construction & Agricultural Machinery, Medical Apparatus, Sports & Marine Equipment.

The Nadella NX bearing is a precision combined bearing that integrates a radial needle roller bearing and a full-complement axial ball bearing into a single, compact unit. It is specifically engineered to handle moderate radial and light axial loads in one direction, primarily in space-constrained machinery. Material : High-quality chrome steel (100Cr6) is used for the rings and rolling elements, with a sheet steel cage for the radial part. Features are : Accommodate radial and axial loads in one direction, High load carrying capacity, Low cross section, Non-separable design, High Temperature Tolerance, Ultra-Low Cross-Section, High Speed Capability,Simplified Installation, Independent Rotational Accuracy. Applications : Textile Machinery, Machine Tools, Printing Presses, Agricultural Machinery, Compressors and Turbines, Packaging Systems.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARINGS WITH INNER RING
tech: The PM bearing is a high-precision intermediate plate (thrust washer) manufactured by Nadella, specifically designed for use with thrust needle or roller bearings. These plates function as hardened raceways when the adjacent machine components cannot be directly hardened to support rolling elements. It is designed to be fully compatible with both AX series (needle thrust) and AR series (roller thrust) assemblies. Material : Made from through-hardened chrome steel with a surface hardness of 58–64 HRC to prevent plastic deformation under heavy axial loads. Features are : Space-Saving Profile, Superior Flatness & Parallelism, Low Friction Operation, Self-Centering Compatibility, High Rigidity, Load Distribution, Wide Tolerance Integration, Low Operating Temperature. Applications : Machine Tools, Pumps and Compressors, Material Handling & Robotics, Pinting Machines, Agricultural Equipment, Textile Machinery, Aerospace & Aviation, Energy & Power Generation, Medical & Laboratory Equipment.

It is designed to be fully compatible with both AX series (needle thrust) and AR series (roller thrust) assemblies. Material : Made from through-hardened chrome steel with a surface hardness of 58–64 HRC to prevent plastic deformation under heavy axial loads. Features are : Space-Saving Profile, Superior Flatness & Parallelism, Low Friction Operation, Self-Centering Compatibility, High Rigidity, Load Distribution, Wide Tolerance Integration, Low Operating Temperature. Applications : Machine Tools, Pumps and Compressors, Material Handling & Robotics, Pinting Machines, Agricultural Equipment, Textile Machinery, Aerospace & Aviation, Energy & Power Generation, Medical & Laboratory Equipment.

The Nadella PMH bearing is a high-precision needle roller bearing typically engineered for heavy-duty industrial and automotive applications. It belongs to Nadella\'s PMH series, which is specifically designed to provide high load-carrying capacity in systems with limited radial space. The \"PMH\" prefix denotes a series of precision bearings that often integrate multiple functions, such as combining radial needle rollers with axial thrust capabilities. Usually a Single-Row Needle Roller Bearing with an open seal design to facilitate continuous lubrication. Material : Manufactured from Chrome Steel or through-hardened bearing steel, providing a surface hardness of 58-64 HRC for maximum wear resistance. Features are : Space-Saving Design, Precision Engineering, Wide Temperature Range, Shaft Raceways, Shock & Vibration Resistance, Lubrication Flexibility, High Rigidity, High Speed. Applications : Automotive Systems, CNC Machine Tool Spindles, Aerospace Components, Automation & Robotics, Construction & Agricultural Equipment, Medical Devices, Fluid Handling, Power Generation, Material Handling.

The \"PMH\" prefix denotes a series of precision bearings that often integrate multiple functions, such as combining radial needle rollers with axial thrust capabilities. Usually a Single-Row Needle Roller Bearing with an open seal design to facilitate continuous lubrication. Material : Manufactured from Chrome Steel or through-hardened bearing steel, providing a surface hardness of 58-64 HRC for maximum wear resistance. Features are : Space-Saving Design, Precision Engineering, Wide Temperature Range, Shaft Raceways, Shock & Vibration Resistance, Lubrication Flexibility, High Rigidity, High Speed. Applications : Automotive Systems, CNC Machine Tool Spindles, Aerospace Components, Automation & Robotics, Construction & Agricultural Equipment, Medical Devices, Fluid Handling, Power Generation, Material Handling.

Alignment needle roller bearings are self-aligning and offer a compact solution in applications where less space is available. Owing to their large number of rollers, they have a high load carrying capacity. Their internal design, where a convex outer ring meets two concave seating rings encased in a drawn sleeve, enables the bearings to compensate for initial errors of alignment. Bearings with an inner ring are used for applications where the shaft cannot be hardened and ground. Materials : It is made from standard bearing steel and is not coated. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, Accommodate static initial misalignment, Low cross-sectional height, Self-aligning capacity, Compact design. Applications : Lifting equipment, Agricultural machinery, Pumps and compressors, Air conditioning units and fans, General engineering, Gearboxes and transmissions, Conveyor system, Mining and construction machinery, Engine components.
