The RNAFW bearing is a double-row, machined-type needle roller bearing without an inner ring. Open type without an inner ring; the rollers run directly on the shaft for improved running accuracy. This \"no inner ring\" design minimizes assembly errors and significantly improves running accuracy and rotational performance. Material : Constructed from high-quality bearing steel with a steel cage. Features are : Compact Radial Space, High-Speed Capability, High Load Ratings, Minimal Maintenance Requirements, Easy Installation, Shaft Raceway, Low Friction & Heat Generation, Space-Saving. Applications : Machine Tools, Printing Equipment, Textile Machinery, Automation & Robotics, Transmission Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Construction Machinery, Medical Devices.

The RNAO bearing is a high-precision, machined needle roller bearing designed without an inner ring. This bearing uses the shaft as the direct raceway, which must be hardened and ground to achieve the required performance. This \"inner-ring-less\" design allows for a larger shaft diameter and increased assembly stiffness within the same housing space. As an RNAO type, it typically features a machined outer ring without integral ribs (flanges), making the outer ring and the needle/cage assembly fully separable for easier mounting. Material : Generally manufactured from High Carbon Chrome Steel (GCr15 equivalent), offering high durability and resistance to wear and tear. Features are : High Load-to-Size Ratio, Space Savings, High Stiffness-to-Envelope Ratio, Separable Components, Direct Shaft Mounting, Precision Standards, Axial Displacement, Thermal Tolerance. Applications : Industrial Gearboxes & Transmissions, Conveyor Systems, Hydraulic Pumps & Compressors, Robotics & Automation, Agriculture & Construction, Medical Equipment, Textile Machinery, Paper & Pulp Processing.

Alignment needle roller bearings are self-aligning and offer a compact solution in applications where less space is available. Owing to their large number of rollers, they have a high load carrying capacity. Their internal design, where a convex outer ring meets two concave seating rings encased in a drawn sleeve, enables the bearings to accommodate initial static misalignment. Bearings without an inner ring are an excellent choice for compact bearing arrangements, if the shaft can be hardened and ground. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, Low cross-sectional height, Accommodate static initial misalignment, Suitable for compact bearing arrangements. Applications : Transportation & Automotive, Material Handling, Robotics & Automation, Food & Packaging, Printing Presses, Pumps & Compressors, Renewable Energy, Construction Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, Medical Equipment.

The IKO CRB...UUC1 bearing is a high-precision, Sealed Standard Crossed Roller Bearing. It is designed a single bearing to simultaneously handle radial, axial (thrust), and moment loads from any direction. Unlike caged versions, this bearing is packed with the maximum number of rollers. This design maximizes the contact area, allowing it to handle significantly higher static  and dynamic loads. In the standard CRB series, the outer ring is split into two pieces that are bolted together to prevent separation during transport and installation. Material : Built from high-quality High Carbon Chromium Steel (GCr15), ensuring long-term durability and resistance to wear. Features are : Precision and Accuracy, Wide Temperature Range, Rotational Efficiency, Compact & Space-Saving, High Rigidity & Minimal Deformation, Optimized Lubrication Path. Applications : Robotics and Automation, Machine Tool Industry, Medical Equipment, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense. UU=Sealed On Both Sides, C1=Radial Internal Clearance.

The IKO CRB...UUT1 bearing is a high-precision, standard-type Crossed Roller Bearing designed to handle complex multi-directional loads in a single, compact unit. This specific model is a Full Complement type, meaning it contains the maximum number of rollers possible for its size, offering superior load capacity compared to versions with cages. Cylindrical rollers are arranged crosswise at 90-degree angles in a \"V\" groove raceway. This allows the bearing to simultaneously manage radial, axial (thrust), and moment (tilting) loads. Standard Type Crossed Roller Bearing series with a separable outer ring held together by a special tape or ring. Material : The bearing and rolling elements are manufactured from High Carbon Chromium Steel. Features are : Simplified Installation, Lubrication Management, Temperature Stability, Limited Space, Low Friction and High Rotational Accuracy. Applications : Machine Tools, Medical Equipment, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Aerospace & Defense. UU=Sealed On Both Sides, T1=Radial Internal Clearance.

The IKO CRBFV....ATUUT1 bearing is a high-rigidity, mounting-holed type crossed roller bearing. AT=Designates female threaded mounting holes on the inner ring, UU=Sealed On Both Sides,T1=T1-Clearance.

Cylindrical rollers are arranged crosswise at 90° V-groove raceways, separated by spacer retainers. This allows a single bearing to replace two conventional bearings. The outer ring is typically divided axially and held by retaining rings, while the inner ring is an integral structure. Material : Typically crafted from high-quality GCr15 (chrome steel) or GCr15SiMn, which provides excellent hardness, wear resistance, and high fatigue life. Features are : Precision and High Rigidity, Spacer Retainers, Open Design, Installation Support, Lubrication Access, Temperature Stability, Minimal Displacement, Simplified Installation. Applications : Robotics and Automation, Machine Tools and Metalworking, Medical and Scientific Equipment, Conveyors and Handling, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Gearbox Systems. VSP=Minimum Bearing Preload.

These bearing a high-precision, thin section crossed roller bearing from the SX series, designed to handle complex load combinations in a single bearing position. It corresponds to dimension series 18 according to DIN 616. This bearing features a unique structure where cylindrical rollers are arranged orthogonally (at 90°) in a V-groove raceway. This enables the bearing to simultaneously support radial loads, axial loads from both directions, and tilting moment loads. The outer ring is circumferentially split and held together by three retaining rings. This design simplifies installation and is ideal for applications where the inner ring rotates. Features are : High Rigidity & Precision, Wide Temperature Range, Reduced Friction and Heat, Reduced Maintenance Costs, Unsealed Design, Easy Installation, Simplified Design, High Speed Limits, Compact Envelope,Open Design. Applications : Robotics & Automation, Machine Tools, Medical Equipment, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Energy & Power Generation, Material Handling Systems, Packaging  & Textile Machinery.

The THK RB series is a high-precision, thin-section Cross-Roller Ring designed for applications where high rotational accuracy of the inner ring is critical. It features a separable outer ring and an integrated inner ring, allowing for a compact design that maintains high rigidity even under complex loading conditions. Cylindrical rollers are arranged perpendicularly in a 90° V-groove. This \"cross\" orientation enables a single bearing to absorb radial, axial, and moment loads simultaneously. Unlike standard sheet metal cages, the THK RB series uses spacer retainers between rollers to prevent skewing and friction-induced torque spikes, ensuring stable rotation even under preload. Material : The rings and rollers are typically crafted from high-carbon chromium bearing steel (GCr15), providing the necessary hardness and fatigue resistance. Features are : Enhanced Rigidity, Space Saving, High Positioning Accuracy, Temperature Resilience, Lubrication System, Cost-Effective Design. Applications : Robotics & Automation, Medical & Precision Equipment, Aerospace and Defence, Wind Turbine Monitoring, Semiconductor Manufacturing.

The THK RB...UUC0P5 bearing is a high-rigidity, split-outer-ring cross-roller ring designed for applications requiring exceptional inner-ring rotation accuracy. Its unique internal structure allows a single bearing to handle complex combined loads that would typically require multiple conventional bearings. The RB type features a two-piece outer ring held together by bolts or specialized retainers once the rollers are installed. This design allows for a one-piece inner ring, which is the "basic form" for high-precision rotary motion. Rollers are arranged orthogonally (at 90-degree angles to each other) within the V-groove raceway. This "crossed" arrangement enables the bearing to support radial, axial, and moment loads simultaneously from any direction. Features are : Resin Spacer Retainers,High Rigidity with Minimal Footprint, Increased Load Capacity, Precision and Smoothness, Low Starting Torque, Integrated Lubrication System, Cost Efficiency in Assembly. Applications : Machine Tools, Medical Equipment, Aerospace and Defense, Semiconductor & LCD Manufacturing, Automotive & Transportation. UU=Seal Attached On Both Ends, C0=Radial Clearance Symbol (Medium Preload), P5=Accuracy Symbol.

These bearing is a heavy-duty single-row cylindrical roller bearing primarily used in industrial applications requiring high radial load capacity and high-speed performance, such as machine tool spindles, electric motors, and gearboxes. This designation typically features a double-ribbed inner ring and a straight (ribless) outer ring. This design allows for axial displacement of the shaft relative to the housing, making it an ideal \"floating\" or \"non-locating\" bearing. The inner and outer rings can be mounted independently, which simplifies installation and maintenance in complex machinery. Material : Usually constructed from high-quality chrome steel (GCr15) for durability. These bearing is a heavy-duty single-row cylindrical roller bearing primarily used in industrial applications requiring high radial load capacity and high-speed performance, such as machine tool spindles, electric motors, and gearboxes. This designation typically features a double-ribbed inner ring and a straight (ribless) outer ring. This design allows for axial displacement of the shaft relative to the housing, making it an ideal \"floating\" or \"non-locating\" bearing. The inner and outer rings can be mounted independently, which simplifies installation and maintenance in complex machinery. Material : Usually constructed from high-quality chrome steel (GCr15) for durability. Features are : High Stiffness, Accommodate Axial Displacement, Long Service Life, Open Flange Design, Vibration Dampening, Low Friction, Installation & Maintenance Features. Applications : Pumps and Compressors, Mining and Construction Equipment, Wind Power Equipment, Textile and Paper Machinery, Metallurgical Equipment, Paper & Pulp Mills, Conveyor Drive Pulleys, Marine Propulsion Shafts.

subName: Cylindrical roller bearings Without Outer Ring
tech: These bearing is a industrial-grade double-row cylindrical roller bearing without an outer ring. This bearing lacks a traditional outer steel ring. Instead, the dual rows of cylindrical rollers run directly against a hardened, precision-ground bore within your machinery\'s housing. This design saves critical radial space and reduces component weight. It features no retaining cage between the rollers. Maximizing the number of rolling elements provides the highest possible radial load rating in this footprint. Material : Manufactured from premium, through-hardened carbon-chromium bearing steel (100Cr6 / SAE 52100) for exceptional wear resistance and structural fatigue life. Features are : Non-Separable Assembly, Exceptional Shock Resistance, Axial Displacement Permissibility, High Rotational Stability, Low Initial Starting Torque, Excellent Vibration Damping. Applications : Construction & Mining Equipment, Renewable Energy & Power Generation, Printing Machinery, Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment. RNN=Double-Row Radial Cylindrical Roller Bearing Without an Outer Ring.

These bearing is a specialized, ultra-heavy-duty four-row cylindrical roller bearing engineered for the extreme environments of rolling mill roll necks. It is designed to manage massive radial loads while maintaining precision under high-speed and high-impact conditions. This multi-row design significantly increases the number of rolling elements, providing the highest possible radial load-carrying capacity. It is specifically engineered to handle the extreme and impact loads of rolling mill back-up rolls. Material : Gcr15 Chrome Steel (high strength and fatigue resistance). Features are : Separable and Interchangeable Parts, Logarithmic Roller Profile, Low Friction Surface Finish, High Rigidity, Precision Rating, Forced Circulation Compatibility. Applications : Paper & Textile Industry, Mining & Construction, Energy Sector, Material Handling, Energy and Power Generation, Oil, Gas, and Marine, Metal Forming and Processing. These bearing is an ultra-heavy-duty four-row cylindrical roller bearing specifically engineered for the demanding environments of metal processing. It is primarily used in rolling mills (both steel and non-ferrous) to support work rolls or backup rolls that face extreme radial pressure and frequent shock loads. All components (inner ring, outer ring, and cage/roller assembly) are completely separable. This allows for the inner ring to be shrink-fitted onto the roll neck while the outer ring is mounted in the housing, facilitating easier maintenance and replacement. Features are : Exceptional Radial Load Capacity, Low Friction & High-Speed Capability, Compact Power Density, Thermal Growth Accommodation, Logarithmic Roller Profile, Lubrication Efficiency, Precision Rolling Accuracy, Enhanced Service Life, Thermal and Operational Stability. Applications : Paper and Plastic Industry, Heavy Construction & Mining, Material Handling, Renewable Energy, Industrial Gearboxes, Large Electric Motor, Precision Printing Presses, Lumber and Pulp Processing. ZL=Machined Solid Brass Cage.

These bearing is a massive, four-row cylindrical roller bearing engineered specifically for the extreme radial loads and harsh environments of rolling mill roll necks. It is a critical component in the production of steel plates, coils, and bars. This design incorporates a maximum number of rollers, making it suitable for very heavy radial loads common in steel and rolling mill industries. The inner and outer rings are separable, which allows for easier mounting, dismounting, and maintenance inspections of the raceways and rollers. Material : Often uses high-purity Super-TF (Tough Steel) or carburized (case-hardened) steel to improve resistance to cracks, shocks, and contaminated lubrication. Features are : Logarithmic Roller Profile, Oil Grooves & Holes, Easy Maintenance & Installation, High Rotational Accuracy, Enhanced Surface Finish, Reduced Operational Costs, Efficient Heat & Friction Management, Improved Rolling Precision. Applications : Paper and Pulp Industry, Large Gearboxes and Power Generation, Mining and Mineral Processing, Cement and Construction, Renewable Energy & Marine, Oil and Gas. RV=Four-Row Cylindrical Roller Bearings.

These bearing is a high-performance four-row cylindrical roller bearing (rolling mill bearing) engineered for applications requiring extreme radial load capacity and high precision. This bearing consists of four rows of cylindrical rollers guided by solid brass or pin-type cages. These bearing is a high-capacity, heavy-duty industrial bearing designed for the world\'s most demanding radial load applications, specifically in large rolling mill stands. This design incorporates a maximum number of rollers, making it suitable for very heavy radial loads common in steel and rolling mill industries. The inner and outer rings are separable, which allows for easier mounting, dismounting, and maintenance inspections of the raceways and rollers. Material : Often uses high-purity Super-TF (Tough Steel) or carburized (case-hardened) steel to improve resistance to cracks, shocks, and contaminated lubrication. Features are : Logarithmic Roller Profile, Oil Grooves & Holes, Easy Maintenance & Installation, High Rotational Accuracy, Enhanced Surface Finish, Reduced Operational Costs, Efficient Heat & Friction Management, Improved Rolling Precision. Applications : Paper and Pulp Industry, Large Gearboxes and Power Generation, Mining and Mineral Processing, Cement and Construction, Renewable Energy & Marine, Oil and Gas. RV=Four-Row Cylindrical Roller Bearings.

These bearing is an ultra-heavy-duty, four-row cylindrical roller bearing designed by steel rolling mill applications. It is engineered to handle extreme radial and impact loads in harsh environments. This bearing is categorized as a \"Roll Neck Bearing\" used primarily on back-up rolls to ensure high precision in metal production. Provides the maximum possible radial load capacity within a limited space compared to single or double-row designs. The inner and outer rings are separable, which facilitates mounting and dismounting of the heavy components. Material : Often utilizes Super-TF (STF) steel, which significantly increases durability and wear resistance when lubrication is compromised by contamination. Features are : Lubrication Enhancement, High Rotational Accuracy, Enhanced Surface Finish (Logarithmic Profiling), Shock & Seizure Resistance, Extended Service Life in Harsh Conditions, Simplified Handling, Heat Management, Cost Savings. Applications : Pulp and Paper Industry, Heavy Industrial Gearboxes, Cement Crushers, Large Drive Systems, Metal Production & Processing, Energy and Power Generation, Marine Propulsion, Oil & Gas. RV=Four-Row Cylindrical Roller Bearing, E=Enhanced Internal Design.

These bearing is a high-capacity, heavy-duty industrial bearing designed for the world\'s most demanding radial load applications, specifically in large rolling mill stands. This configuration maximizes the number of rollers to achieve exceptional radial load capacity while maintaining a low cross-sectional height, allowing for larger roll neck diameters relative to the total roll size. Unlike smaller bearings that use brass or pressed steel, this size typically uses a steel pin-type cage. This design utilizes hollow rollers through which the pins pass, allowing for a higher roller density and superior load distribution. Features are : Extreme Radial Load Capacity, Separable & Interchangeable, Thermal Stability & Clearance, Lubricant Flow Management, Space Efficiency, Applications : Steel and Metal Production, Mining and Quarrying, Cement and Construction, Wind Turbines, Power Transmission Systems, Paper and Printing, Industrial Gearboxes.

These bearing is a precision-engineered, large-bore four-row cylindrical roller bearing. It is specifically designed for the roll necks of rolling mills, where it must manage extreme radial loads and facilitate high-speed operations. This model typically utilizes a pin-type cage featuring hollow rollers. This allows for the maximum number of rollers to be packed into the bearing, providing the highest possible radial load capacity. Material : Often constructed from carburized (case-hardened) steel. This material choice is vital for steel mill applications to prevent inner ring cracking and improve overall shock resistance. Features are : Shock and Impact Resistance, Logarithmic Roller Profile, High-Speed Stability, Reduced Operational Friction, Low Cross-Sectional Height, Ease of Maintenance, Precision Tolerance and Fit, Increased Service Life. Applications : Paper Industry, Mining and Construction, Crushers and Conveyors, Energy and Power Generation, Metallurgical and Processing Equipment, Bending and Straightening Machines, Heavy-Duty Industrial Gearboxes. FC=Four-row Cylindrical Roller Bearing.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. Having two integral flanges on the inner ring and no flanges on the outer ring, N design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in both directions. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design, Logarithmic Roller Profile, Temperature Stability, Open Flange Design, Rotational Speeds. Applications : Wind Turbine Generators, Machine Tool Spindles, Industrial Gearboxes, Paper and Pulp Machinery, Centrifugal Pumps & Compressors,  Construction Machinery, Material Handling & Mining, Power Generation & Renewable Energy, Heavy Marine & Offshore Engineering.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. Having two integral flanges on the inner ring and no flanges on the outer ring, N design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in both directions. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Accommodate Axial Displacement In Both Directions, Separable Design. Applications : Wind Turbine Generators, Machine Tool Spindles, Industrial Gearboxes, Paper and Pulp Machinery, Centrifugal Pumps & Compressors, Material Handling & Mining, Industrial Blowers & Fans. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, P= Injection Moulded Cage Of Glass Fibre Reinforced Polyamide 6,6, Roller Centered, C3=Internal Clearance Larger Than Normal.

An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are: High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction, Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In One Direction, Separable Design. Applications : Wind Turbine Generators, Machine Tool Spindles, Industrial Gearboxes, Paper and Pulp Machinery, Centrifugal Pumps & Compressors, Material Handling & Mining, Industrial Blowers & Fans. EC= Optimized Internal Design Incorporating More And/Or Larger Rollers And With Modified Roller/End Flange Contact, P= Injection Moulded Cage Of Glass Fibre Reinforced Polyamide 6,6, Roller Centered, C3=Internal Clearance Larger Than Normal.

subName: Cylindrical Roller Bearings With Cage Units
tech: Single row cylindrical roller bearings are designed to accommodate high radial loads in combination with high speeds. NU design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in both directions since they have two integral flanges on the outer ring and no flanges on the inner ring. NJ design bearings can accommodate axial displacement in one direction since they have two integral flanges on the outer ring and one on the inner ring. An important feature is the separable design, which facilitates mounting and enables the bearing components to be interchanged. Features are : High Radial Load Carrying Capacity, Low Friction And Long Service Life, Locate The Shaft Axially In One Direction, Separable Design, High-Speed Performance, Logarithmic Roller Profile, Thermal Stability. Applications : Mining Equipment, Construction Machinery, Heavy-Duty Gearboxes, Large Electric Motors, Centrifugal Pumps & Compressors, Power Generators, Paper Mills, Steel Rolling Mills, Agricultural Tractors, Textile Machinery.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING WITH INNER RING
tech: The Nadella NA..DELTA is a high-capacity radial needle roller bearing designed for heavy industrial machinery. It features a solid, machined, and through-hardened outer ring paired with a removable inner ring. It is utilizes a full complement of needle rollers packed tightly together. This dramatically increases the surface area distributing the load, giving it extraordinarily high static and dynamic load-carrying ratings. The outer ring assembly (with its rollers) and the inner ring can be split apart during installation. This separable design simplifies mounting, maintenance, and system alignment. Features are : Built-in Relubrication, Bi-Directional Axial Displacement Accommodation, Ultra-Smooth Raceway Superfinish, Friction Coefficient. Applications : Pumps & Compressors, Robotic Articulations and Joints, Printing & Paper Processing Equipment, Medical & Laboratory Instrumentation, Woodworking Machinery, Aerospace, Defence & Marine Actuation. DELTA= High-Precision Adjustable Preload Suffix.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING WITH INNER RING
tech: The NK is a standard metric, single-row needle roller bearing without an inner ring. It features a machined outer ring with flanges to guide the needle rollers and cage assembly. Because it has no inner ring, it uses the hardened and ground surface of the machine shaft itself as its inner raceway, making it highly suitable for compact spaces with high radial loads. Material : Through-hardened chrome steel (100Cr6) outer ring and rollers. Features are : Low Profile, Excellent Rigidity, Minimal Friction, High-Speed Rating, Low Inertia, Extreme Heat Resistance, Flanged Axial Guidance, Bi-Directional Operation, Zero Moisture Absorption, Predictable Fatigue Life, Vibration Damping. Applications : Machine Tool Spindles, Textile Machinery, Power Tool Gearheads, Printing Presses, Aerospace Control Actuators, Woodworking Routers, Packaging Machinery, Paper Processing Calenders.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING WITH INNER RING
tech: The NADELLA NKI is a high-capacity, single-row machined needle roller bearing that comes complete with a removable inner ring. It is specifically engineered to handle massive radial loads within highly restricted, compact installation spaces. The separable design allows you to mount the inner and outer rings independently. If your shaft is already hardened and ground, you can discard the inner ring to save even more radial space. Features an integrated lubrication groove and oil holes in the outer ring for simple maintenance. Feature are : High-Rigidity Solid Outer Ring, High Wear Resistance, High Radial Stiffness, Space-to-Power Ratio, High Power Density, Low Profile, Axial Displacement Accommodation, Low Running Friction & Vibration Control, Temperature Range. Applications : Automotive & Powertrain Systems, Industrial Fluid Power & Compressors, Heavy-Duty Pneumatic & Electric Tools, Textile & Printing Presses, Packaging and Bottling Lines, Metalworking Machine Tools, Construction & Agricultural Equipment, Lifting and Material Handling.

These bearing is a high-precision, military-grade double-row airframe control needle roller bearing. This heavy-duty component is engineered for extreme structural and mechanical loads in aerospace, defense, and specialized industrial track systems. The bearing is fundamentally a track roller variant designed for oscillating or slow-rotation applications under intense pressure. Unlike standard commercial bearings, it features a highly robust, thick-walled outer ring designed to roll directly on tracks, cams, or guide rails without bending or fracturing. It utilizes two parallel rows of needle rollers housed without a cage (full-complement design), maximizing the internal contact surface area to handle massive radial and shock loads. It is engineered with a passivated or plated finish to survive harsh environmental exposure. Applications : Packaging & Textile Machinery, Material Handling Equipment, Robotic Joints & Arm Pivots, Marine & Subsea Infrastructure. YJ = Precision Clearance & Seal Specification, B= Factory Lubricant & Surface Finishing Variant.

These bearing is a highly specialized, heavy-duty single-row machined-ring needle roller bearing without an inner ring. This specific bearing is designed to handle exceptionally high radial loads inside extremely tight physical spaces, commonly serving as a critical automotive gearbox or wheel hub bearing. Material : The bearing is manufactured from through-hardened, high-carbon chromium steel (GCr15) with an engineered rigid steel cage to maximize wear resistance and structural fatigue life. Features are : High-Speed Threshold, Shock and Impact Absorption, Harsh Temperature Resilience, Open Architecture, Vibration Dampening Harmonic Profilex, Integrated Lubrication Pathway. Applications : Industrial Gearboxes & Reducers, Machine Tool Spindles, Agricultural Machinery, Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Fluid Power & Hydraulic Systems, Textile Manufacturing Machinery, Printing Press Cylinders.

These bearing is a high-capacity full complement drawn cup needle roller bearing. It is primarily engineered for mechanical assemblies that demand maximum radial load-bearing capacity within an extremely narrow radial cross-section. The outer shell is made of a thin, precision-formed piece of carbon steel. This cup is case-hardened to provide a durable raceway for the rollers while keeping the overall wall thickness minimal. Both faces of the bearing are open. This allows for a continuous flow of lubrication (either oil or grease) directly through the housing assembly. Features are : Low-Speed Efficiency, Space Saving, Thermal Resilience and Operating Limits, Elimination of Axial Retention Components. Applicaitons : Agricultural & Construction Machinery, Industrial Pumps & Compressors, Energy & Power Generation Infrastructure, Aerospace & Defense Support Equipment, Medical & Material Processing Machinery.

These bearing is a precision-engineered, metric-sized radial needle roller and cage assembly. Designed without integrated inner or outer rings, it provides exceptional radial load capacity within an ultra-thin cross-section. It is heavily utilized in high-performance, tight-clearance industrial machinery and automotive drivetrains. Features an open design with no built-in seals or shields, allowing direct submersion in oil baths or exposure to targeted grease delivery systems. Houses one row of highly parallel needle rollers arranged uniformly around the pitch circle. Material : This assembly uses a surface-hardened carbon steel cage paired with high-strength, through-hardened chrome steel needle rollers to maximize fatigue life. Features are : Low Starting Torque, High Rigidity, Low Rotational Inertia, Robust Shock Resistance, Excellent Heat Dissipation. Applications : Agricultural Machinery, Construction Equipment, Machine Tool Spindles, Textile & Printing Presses, Marine Propulsion Drives, Mining & Quarrying Machinery, Paper Mill Processing Rolls.

These bearing is a highly specialized, industrial-grade drawn cup needle roller bearing designed and manufactured by Nadella. It is engineered primarily for high-load applications working under tight structural spaces. The \"cup\" is formed from thin, precision-stamped sheet steel. This design allows it to have an incredibly small radial cross-section. It provides the maximum possible load-bearing capacity relative to the tiny amount of space it takes up inside a machine housing. The inner needle rollers are engineered with a modified geometry. This specialized profiling ensures that load distribution is perfectly even across the length of the roller, eliminating tension spikes at the edges and significantly extending the mechanical service life of the bearing. Features are : High-Speed RPM Capacity, Low Initial Startup Torque, Shaft-as-Raceway Operation, High Rotational Threshold, Minimized Oscillation Resistance, Broad Thermal Window. Applications : Pneumatic & Hydraulic Pumps, Textile Machinery, Aerospace & Defense Machinery, Material Handling Equipment, Medical Equipment & Lab Automation, Marine & Agricultural Infrastructure. LB=Radial Internal Clearance Class, EA= Proprietary Factory Lubrication & Treatment.

These bearing is a highly specialized, heavy-duty stud-type track roller bearing (cam follower). Built with a solid, high-tensile steel mounting stud instead of a standard inner ring. The threaded shaft ensures direct installation onto machine frames using a standard hexagonal locking nut. Features either a high-density, full-complement needle roller array or a caged cylindrical roller configuration. This structure yields maximum load-carrying density within a compact, tight space envelope. Material : It is made of high-strength chrome steel (typically 100Cr6) for the rolling elements. Features are : High-Capacity Roller Array, Thick-Walled Outer Ring, Compact Structural Envelope, Low Boundary Friction Profile, Low Heat Generation, Protection & Lifecycle Extended, Simplified Maintenance, Space-Saving Footprint. Applications : Material Handling, Packaging & Bottling Machinery, Textile & Printing Industries, Food, Beverage & Cleanroom Processing, Energy & Heavy Infrastructure Machinery.

The Guiderol GR series is a heavy-duty, machined race full complement radial needle roller bearing. It is designed for applications where high radial stiffness and extreme radial load-carrying capabilities are required within a compact or restricted mounting space. The rollers are uniquely undercut on their outside diameters on each side of the center. This forms a precise circumferential groove that meshes with a guide rail inside the housing, minimizing roller skewing and friction without the need for a traditional cage or retainer. Containing no cage, the entire internal volume of the race is packed with needle rollers. Unlike thin-walled drawn cup bearings, the outer ring is precision-machined from thick alloy steel to withstand severe radial stress, shock loads, and high-frequency oscillating environments. Features are : Integrated Relubrication System, High Line-Contact Footprint, Ultra-Low Section Profile. Applications : Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Metal Processing & Steel Mill Machinery, Industrial Gearboxes & Power Transmission, Marine & Offshore Engineering, Textile & Printing Press Rollers.

The Guiderol GR..RS is a heavy-duty, machined race needle roller bearing designed for high radial load capacities in confined spaces. This bearing features a full complement of center-guided rollers and an integrated single rubber lip seal.  Completely filled with rolling elements without a traditional cage/retainer. This maximizes the total contact area, making it ideal for high static loads or low-speed oscillating applications. Features a unique design where rollers are guided by a central mechanism to significantly minimize skewing and reduce internal operational friction. Features are : Zero Thrust Tolerance Design, High Heat Dissipation, Controlled Thermal Expansion, Shaft-Riding Versatility, Super-Finished Raceways, Low Rotational Inertia, Vibration Dampening Film. Applications : Construction & Material Handling, Metal Rolling Mills, Textile Machinery, Printing Presses, Paper Mill Rollers, Power Transmission & Gear Systems, Agriculture & Forestry Equipment, Marine & Offshore Engineering, Renewable Energy Systems. RS=Single Synthetic Rubber Lip Seal.

The Guiderol GR..RSS is a highly specialised, premium-grade machined race radial needle roller bearing. It features a full-complement design with double rubber-lipped contact seals to provide extreme radial stiffness in space-restricted environments. Unlike standard needle bearings that use a steel or polyamide separator cage, the GR series uses a full complement of needle rollers without a cage retainer. A center-guiding mechanism uses a raised integral rib on the outer raceway to track a corresponding groove machined into the center of each individual needle roller. Features are : Superior Contamination Exclusion, Built-in Relubrication System, High Rigidity & Zero-Internal Looseness Adaptation, Self-Retaining Design, Low Start-Up Torque, Fatigue Resistance. Applications : Hydraulic Pumps and Motors, Textile Machinery, Printing Presses, Gearboxes and Reducers, Material Handling & Conveyor, Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Steel Rolling Mills, Machine Tool Spindles, Aerospace & Defense. RSS=Double Rubber Seals (Outward Facing).

The GR...S bearing is a specialized heavy-duty machined race needle roller bearing without an inner ring. The rollers are guided by a central mechanism rather than their ends. This reduces friction, prevents roller skewing (misalignment), and ensures smooth rotation under heavy stress. Featuring a full complement of center-guided needle rollers rather than traditional caged or standard multi-rolled configurations. It contains a full set of center-guided needle rollers without a traditional retaining cage, yielding exceptionally high radial load capacities. Material : It is constructed from through-hardened AISI 52100 high-carbon chrome steel. Features are : No Inner Ring, Integrated Relubrication Features, Oscillating Motion Optimization, Martensitic Heat Treatment, Non-Separable Unit. Applications : Hydraulic Pumps and Motors, Textile Machinery, Material Handling Equipment, Packaging Machinery, Printing Presses, Agricultural Implements, Construction Vehicles, Oilfield and Mining Equipment. S=Single Rubber Lip Seal.

The Guiderol GR...SRS is a heavy-duty, high-capacity machined race radial needle roller bearing designed to provide robust performance in space-restricted industrial applications. Features a cageless design (no retainer) packed tightly with barrel-shaped needle rollers. This design maximizes contact surface area to deliver the highest possible radial stiffness and load capacity. The rollers are precision-guided by an integrated rib on the outer race channel. This prevents roller skewing under heavy, pulsating, or intermittent loads and accommodates slight shaft misalignments. Material: The outer race and rolling elements are forged from through-hardened 52100 high-carbon chromium bearing steel. Features are : Direct-Shaft Running, Space Efficiency, Easy Maintenance, Non-Separable Unit, Extended Fatigue Life, High Power Density, Compact Footprint, High Radial Rigidity, Exceptional Oscillation Support. Applications : Materials Handling, Construction & Agricultural Equipment, Printing, Paper & Textile Processing, Metalworking & Machine Tools, Packaging & Food Processing Machinery, Wood, Pulp & Paper Processing, Fluid Power & Pumping Systems. SRS=Synthetic Rubber Seals On Both Sides.

The GR...SS is a heavy-duty machined-race radial needle roller bearing featuring a full complement of rollers and double lip seals. GUIDEROL® series, this bearing is built to handle extreme radial loads in applications with limited radial space. Because it is engineered with a full complement of rollers rather than a traditional cage, it sacrifices high-speed capability to maximize its load-bearing capacity and resistance to shock. Material : Made from through-hardened, high-carbon 52100 chrome steel with steel-reinforced synthetic nitrile rubber seals. Features are : Integrated Lubrication Groove and Hole, Separable Architecture, Extreme Radial Rigidity, Oscillating Motion Specialization, Low Initial Startup Drag, Shaft Requirements, High Speed & Temperature. Applications : Textile and Printing Machinery, Agricultural Equipment, Packaging and Bottling Lines, Construction Machinery, Material Handling & Lifting Equipment, Pumps and Compressors. SS=Integral Double Seals.

It features a full-complement design with double rubber-lipped contact seals to provide extreme radial stiffness in space-restricted environments. Unlike standard needle bearings that use a steel or polyamide separator cage, the GR series uses a full complement of needle rollers without a cage retainer. A center-guiding mechanism uses a raised integral rib on the outer raceway to track a corresponding groove machined into the center of each individual needle roller. Features are : Superior Contamination Exclusion, Built-in Relubrication System, High Rigidity & Zero-Internal Looseness Adaptation, Self-Retaining Design, Low Start-Up Torque, Fatigue Resistance. Applications : Hydraulic Pumps and Motors, Textile Machinery, Printing Presses, Gearboxes and Reducers, Material Handling & Conveyor, Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Steel Rolling Mills, Machine Tool Spindles, Aerospace & Defense. RSS=Double Rubber Seals (Outward Facing).

The GR...S bearing is a specialized heavy-duty machined race needle roller bearing without an inner ring. The rollers are guided by a central mechanism rather than their ends. This reduces friction, prevents roller skewing (misalignment), and ensures smooth rotation under heavy stress. Featuring a full complement of center-guided needle rollers rather than traditional caged or standard multi-rolled configurations. It contains a full set of center-guided needle rollers without a traditional retaining cage, yielding exceptionally high radial load capacities. Material : It is constructed from through-hardened AISI 52100 high-carbon chrome steel. Features are : No Inner Ring, Integrated Relubrication Features, Oscillating Motion Optimization, Martensitic Heat Treatment, Non-Separable Unit. Applications : Hydraulic Pumps and Motors, Textile Machinery, Material Handling Equipment, Packaging Machinery, Printing Presses, Agricultural Implements, Construction Vehicles, Oilfield and Mining Equipment. S=Single Rubber Lip Seal.

The Guiderol GR...SRS is a heavy-duty, high-capacity machined race radial needle roller bearing designed to provide robust performance in space-restricted industrial applications. Features a cageless design (no retainer) packed tightly with barrel-shaped needle rollers. This design maximizes contact surface area to deliver the highest possible radial stiffness and load capacity. The rollers are precision-guided by an integrated rib on the outer race channel. This prevents roller skewing under heavy, pulsating, or intermittent loads and accommodates slight shaft misalignments. Material: The outer race and rolling elements are forged from through-hardened 52100 high-carbon chromium bearing steel. Features are : Direct-Shaft Running, Space Efficiency, Easy Maintenance, Non-Separable Unit, Extended Fatigue Life, High Power Density, Compact Footprint, High Radial Rigidity, Exceptional Oscillation Support. Applications : Materials Handling, Construction & Agricultural Equipment, Printing, Paper & Textile Processing, Metalworking & Machine Tools, Packaging & Food Processing Machinery, Wood, Pulp & Paper Processing, Fluid Power & Pumping Systems. SRS=Synthetic Rubber Seals On Both Sides.

The Guiderol GR series is a heavy-duty, machined race full complement radial needle roller bearing. It is designed for applications where high radial stiffness and extreme radial load-carrying capabilities are required within a compact or restricted mounting space. The rollers are uniquely undercut on their outside diameters on each side of the center. This forms a precise circumferential groove that meshes with a guide rail inside the housing, minimizing roller skewing and friction without the need for a traditional cage or retainer. Containing no cage, the entire internal volume of the race is packed with needle rollers. Unlike thin-walled drawn cup bearings, the outer ring is precision-machined from thick alloy steel to withstand severe radial stress, shock loads, and high-frequency oscillating environments. Features are : Integrated Relubrication System, High Line-Contact Footprint, Ultra-Low Section Profile. Applications : Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Metal Processing & Steel Mill Machinery, Industrial Gearboxes & Power Transmission, Marine & Offshore Engineering, Textile & Printing Press Rollers.

SS=Integral Double Seals.

The Guiderol GR series is a heavy-duty, machined race full complement radial needle roller bearing. It is designed for applications where high radial stiffness and extreme radial load-carrying capabilities are required within a compact or restricted mounting space. The rollers are uniquely undercut on their outside diameters on each side of the center. This forms a precise circumferential groove that meshes with a guide rail inside the housing, minimizing roller skewing and friction without the need for a traditional cage or retainer. Containing no cage, the entire internal volume of the race is packed with needle rollers. Unlike thin-walled drawn cup bearings, the outer ring is precision-machined from thick alloy steel to withstand severe radial stress, shock loads, and high-frequency oscillating environments. Features are : Integrated Relubrication System, High Line-Contact Footprint, Ultra-Low Section Profile. Applications : Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Metal Processing & Steel Mill Machinery, Industrial Gearboxes & Power Transmission, Marine & Offshore Engineering, Textile & Printing Press Rollers.

The Guiderol GR..RS is a heavy-duty, machined race needle roller bearing designed for high radial load capacities in confined spaces. The Guiderol GR..RSS is a highly specialised, premium-grade machined race radial needle roller bearing. It features a full-complement design with double rubber-lipped contact seals to provide extreme radial stiffness in space-restricted environments. Unlike standard needle bearings that use a steel or polyamide separator cage, the GR series uses a full complement of needle rollers without a cage retainer. A center-guiding mechanism uses a raised integral rib on the outer raceway to track a corresponding groove machined into the center of each individual needle roller. Features are : Superior Contamination Exclusion, Built-in Relubrication System, High Rigidity & Zero-Internal Looseness Adaptation, Self-Retaining Design, Low Start-Up Torque, Fatigue Resistance. Applications : Hydraulic Pumps and Motors, Textile Machinery, Printing Presses, Gearboxes and Reducers, Material Handling & Conveyor, Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Steel Rolling Mills, Machine Tool Spindles, Aerospace & Defense. RSS=Double Rubber Seals (Outward Facing).

The GR...S bearing is a specialized heavy-duty machined race needle roller bearing without an inner ring. The rollers are guided by a central mechanism rather than their ends. This reduces friction, prevents roller skewing (misalignment), and ensures smooth rotation under heavy stress. Featuring a full complement of center-guided needle rollers rather than traditional caged or standard multi-rolled configurations. It contains a full set of center-guided needle rollers without a traditional retaining cage, yielding exceptionally high radial load capacities. Material : It is constructed from through-hardened AISI 52100 high-carbon chrome steel. Features are : No Inner Ring, Integrated Relubrication Features, Oscillating Motion Optimization, Martensitic Heat Treatment, Non-Separable Unit. Applications : Hydraulic Pumps and Motors, Textile Machinery, Material Handling Equipment, Packaging Machinery, Printing Presses, Agricultural Implements, Construction Vehicles, Oilfield and Mining Equipment. S=Single Rubber Lip Seal.

The Guiderol GR series is a heavy-duty, machined race full complement radial needle roller bearing. It is designed for applications where high radial stiffness and extreme radial load-carrying capabilities are required within a compact or restricted mounting space. The rollers are uniquely undercut on their outside diameters on each side of the center. This forms a precise circumferential groove that meshes with a guide rail inside the housing, minimizing roller skewing and friction without the need for a traditional cage or retainer. Containing no cage, the entire internal volume of the race is packed with needle rollers. Unlike thin-walled drawn cup bearings, the outer ring is precision-machined from thick alloy steel to withstand severe radial stress, shock loads, and high-frequency oscillating environments. Features are : Integrated Relubrication System, High Line-Contact Footprint, Ultra-Low Section Profile. Applications : Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Metal Processing & Steel Mill Machinery, Industrial Gearboxes & Power Transmission, Marine & Offshore Engineering, Textile & Printing Press Rollers.

Provides a rigid and robust shell structure capable of enduring high structural fatigue and heavy radial shock loads. Material: High-carbon 52100 chrome bearing steel. Features are : High Radial Load Density, Thick-Walled Structural Integrity, Low Axial Profile, Optimized Roller Guiding, High Lubricant Retention, Low Starting and Running Torque, Broad Operating Thermal, Exceptional Radial Stiffness. Applications : Industrial Gearboxes & Speed Reducers, Material Handling & Construction Equipment, Automotive, Truck, & Aerospace Systems, Fluid Handling & Power Equipment, Machine Tool Spindles, Mining and Quarrying Equipment, Packaging and Bottling Lines, Marine Propulsion Auxiliary Drives, Paper and Pulp Processing Mills. N=Narrow Width.

The Nadella NKIS is a heavy-series, single-row machined needle roller bearing that includes an inner ring. This specific bearing model is designed for high radial load capacities in highly compact, space-restricted industrial applications. Features a lower cross-sectional height but a thicker, sturdier outer ring profile compared to standard needle bearings. The inner ring can be detached from the cage and outer ring. This makes it ideal for setups where the shaft itself cannot be induction-hardened or precision-ground to serve as a direct raceway. Material : Made of premium 100Cr6 high-carbon chromium steel through-hardened for maximum wear resistance. Features are : Accommodating Axial Displacement, Built-in Relubrication Groove, Optimized Roller Profile, Wide Operating Temperature, Low Starting Torque, High Geometric Running Accuracy, High Stiffness. Applications : CNC Machine Tools, Packaging Machinery, Textile Equipment, Construction Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, Paper Processing Equipment, Renewable Energy Systems, Marine Propulsion Units, Woodworking Machinery.

The Nadella NKS is a high-performance, single-row needle roller bearing with machined rings and flanges, designed without an inner ring. Because it lacks an inner ring, it uses a hardened and ground shaft as its internal raceway, making it an exceptional choice for highly compact machine assemblies that require high radial stiffness. A massive radial load-carrying capabilities while keeping the mechanical profile remarkably small. The outer ring features two heavy-duty integral flanges to guide the needle and cage assembly smoothly. Features are : Accommodates Axial Displacement, High Operational Speeds, Low Radial Profile, Non-Locating Design, Martensitic Heat Treatment, Logarithmic Roller Profiling, Low Initial Friction Torque. Applications : Textile Machinery, Printing Presses, Packaging Equipment, Machine Tools & Precision Equipment, Construction, Agriculture & Material Handling, Power Generation & Renewable Energy, Aerospace, Defense & Marine Systems.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING WITH THRUST BEARING
tech: The Nadella NKX is a high-precision, heavy-duty combined needle roller and thrust ball bearing designed to handle both heavy radial loads and single-direction axial (thrust) loads simultaneously within an exceptionally compact footprint. Needle roller and cage assembly that delivers maximum radial load ratings relative to its tiny cross-section. It does not feature an inner ring by default; the needle rollers run directly on the shaft. A single-direction thrust ball bearing mounted at one end of the needle assembly to capture thrust forces. Material : Made of through-hardened 100Cr6 chrome steel structure with a pressed steel or polyamide cage.Features are : Low Mass Moment of Inertia, Non-Separable Unit Security, Simplified Assembly Line Processing, Logarithmic Roller Profile, High-Speed Smoothness, Controlled Axial Displacement. Applications : Automation and Robotics, Machine Tools and Metalworking, Gearboxes and Transmissions, Textile Machinery, Printing Presses, Hydraulic/Pneumatic Pumps, Packaging and Material Handling.

Needle roller and cage assembly that delivers maximum radial load ratings relative to its tiny cross-section. It does not feature an inner ring by default; the needle rollers run directly on the shaft. A single-direction thrust ball bearing mounted at one end of the needle assembly to capture thrust forces. Material : Made of through-hardened 100Cr6 chrome steel structure with a pressed steel or polyamide cage. Features are : Low Mass Moment of Inertia, Non-Separable Unit Security, Simplified Assembly Line Processing, Logarithmic Roller Profile, High-Speed Smoothness, Controlled Axial Displacement. Applications : Automation and Robotics, Machine Tools and Metalworking, Gearboxes and Transmissions, Textile Machinery, Printing Presses, Hydraulic/Pneumatic Pumps, Packaging and Material Handling. Z=Shield Of Pressed Sheet Steel On One Side Of The Bearing.

desc: NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING WITH THRUST BEARING
tech: The NKXR bearing is a heavy-duty, high-precision combined needle roller and axial cylindrical roller thrust bearing designed to support both high radial and heavy axial loads within an extremely compact footprint. It integrates two distinct bearing components into a single outer ring assembly: a radial needle roller cage and an axial cylindrical roller cage. Comprises long needle rollers held in a rigid cage inside the outer ring to support high radial loads. Comprises a cylindrical roller and cage thrust assembly, backed by a flange on the outer ring, designed to handle high axial forces in one direction. Material : High-carbon chromium bearing steel (typically 100Cr6) for maximum hardness and wear resistance. Features are : High Load Rating in a Compact Space, High Rigidity and Accuracy, Integrated Lubrication System, Low Heat Generation, High-Speed Retention, Low Frictional Torque. Applications : Machine Tools & Precision Machining, Industrial Fans & Blowers, Agricultural Machinery, Textile Machinery, Packaging Machinery, Material Handling Conveyors, Woodworking Machinery, Medical Equipment, Marine Propulsion Units.

tech: The NKXR bearing is a heavy-duty, high-precision combined needle roller and axial cylindrical roller thrust bearing designed to support both high radial and heavy axial loads within an extremely compact footprint. It integrates two distinct bearing components into a single outer ring assembly: a radial needle roller cage and an axial cylindrical roller cage. Comprises long needle rollers held in a rigid cage inside the outer ring to support high radial loads. Comprises a cylindrical roller and cage thrust assembly, backed by a flange on the outer ring, designed to handle high axial forces in one direction. Material : High-carbon chromium bearing steel (typically 100Cr6) for maximum hardness and wear resistance. Features are : High Load Rating in a Compact Space, High Rigidity and Accuracy, Integrated Lubrication System, Low Heat Generation, High-Speed Retention, Low Frictional Torque. Applications : Machine Tools & Precision Machining, Industrial Fans & Blowers, Agricultural Machinery, Textile Machinery, Packaging Machinery, Material Handling Conveyors, Woodworking Machinery, Medical Equipment, Marine Propulsion Units.

The NTA is a premium, metric-series axial needle roller and cage thrust assembly designed to handle heavy directional thrust loads within highly restricted, compact spaces. This low-profile assembly utilizes long, thin needle rollers nested within a durable steel cage to minimize friction and evenly distribute immense axial pressure. The NTA is only a combination of rollers and a cage, it must run against a precision-hardened, flat ground surface. If mating housings or shaft shoulders cannot be heat-treated to an equivalent HRC 58-64 hardness, you must combine the assembly with matching metric-series thrust washers. Features are : Ultra-Low Section Height, Optimized Lubricant Windows, Low Startup Torque, Operating Temperature Limits, Limiting Speed. Applications : Construction Transmissions, Hydraulic Pumps & Motors, Agricultural Tractors, Machine Tool Spindles, Aerospace & Marine Systems, Power Generation & Energy Systems, Material Handling & Logistics Equipment, Printing, Paper, & Packaging Equipment.

This minimizes the radial space required for installation. Material : The bearing is made of high-grade, through-hardened carbon steel for maximum durability and shock resistance. Features are : High-Speed Capability, High Rigidity, Low Starting Torque, High Lubricant Retention, Excellent Fatigue Life, Interchangeable Design, Low Inertia, High Oscillating Stability. Applications : Engineering and Earthmoving Machinery, Textile Spinning Machinery, Printing Press Rollers, Material Handling Conveyor Drives, Agricultural Equipment, Construction Power Tools, Steel & Metal Processing Equipment.

The RANL bearing is a single-row, full-complement needle roller track roller. It is engineered primarily for compact industrial guiding systems and cam drives, functioning without an integrated inner ring. Mounts directly onto a ground and hardened shaft or pin. This design saves critical radial space in compact assemblies. A retaining cage, maximizing the number of needle rollers packed inside. This layout provides exceptionally high radial load capacity for its miniature footprint. The outer diameter profile is slightly crowned or spherical. This prevents edge stress if the bearing undergoes angular misalignment during operation. Material : It is made of through-hardened high-carbon chromium steel (GCr15/AISI 52100) to provide extreme wear resistance. Features are : Shaft Tolerances, Lubrication Requirements, Friction-Generated Heat Dissipation, Open Design, Low-Speed Optimization, Operating Temperature. Applications : Packaging Machinery, Textile Machinery, Material Handling Conveyors, Printing Presses, Medical & Laboratory Equipment, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Food Processing Machinery.

These bearing is a industrial-grade single-row radial cylindrical roller bearing designed by INA. Built for extreme radial loads in compact envelopes, it omits a traditional retaining cage to maximize the number of rolling elements. These bearing is a high-precision needle roller bearing with a closed end, manufactured by INA. It functions without an inner ring and features a specialized cup or cap layout, providing rugged protection against contaminants while ensuring exceptional radial load capacities. Features are : Direct Shaft Operation, Optimized Roller Profile, Low Rotational Inertia, Compact Cross-Section, Lubricant Retention, Extreme Radial Capacity, High-Speed Oscillatory Damping, High-Precision Tolerance. G=Closed-End Design, K=Contact Lip Seal, B=Full Complement (Cageless) Layout.

These bearing is a high-precision single-row cylindrical roller bearing manufactured by INA. It features a configuration designed without an outer ring. Instead of a single point of contact (like ball bearings), the cylindrical/needle elements utilize line contact. This distributes heavy forces across a larger surface area, dramatically increasing structural rigidity and enabling smaller rolling elements to carry identical or larger loads. The bearing assembly forms a ready-to-fit unit where the inner and outer rings can be separated during installation. This permits independent press-fitting of both rings onto the shaft and into the housing, ensuring tight fits that prevent internal slipping. Material : Made of high-purity, carbonitride-hardened 100Cr6 chrome steel with a high-strength pressed steel cage. Features are : Non-Locating Axial Compensation, High Speed Capacity, Low Boundary Friction, High Temperatures. Applications : Hydraulic Pump & Motor Drives, Construction & Earthmoving Equipment, Machine Tool Spindles, Textile Machinery Feed Rollers, Agricultural Machinery.
